-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Add Prefix to Map Fields.lua 
--   Version      : WindMil 8.1
--   Input        : Selection set
--   Return       : Number of elements modified
--   Description  : Adds a prefix to the beginning of the map field of every element in the selection set.
--   Customer     : None
-- END DESCRIPTION

local changeCount = 0
errCount = 0
local prefix = PromptString( 'Enter the prefix that you would like to use.', '' )
PushDrawingEnabled( false )
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()

function CheckLength( newName )
	if #newName > GetMapNumberLength() then return false end
	return true
end

function WriteError( e, newName )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Add Prefix to Map Fields.lua', errCode = 2, message = newName..
					' is not a valid name because it is longer than '..GetMapNumberLength()..
					' characters.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

local prompt = GetGridEditPromptStatus()
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	local mapName = e:getElementField( 'Map Name' )
	if mapName then -- map points have a nil 'Map Name'
		local newName = prefix..mapName
		if CheckLength( newName ) then
			if prompt then
				local result = MultipleChoice( e:name()..' will be renamed to '..newName,
							{'Change', 'Skip', 'Change All', 'Skip All'} )
				if result == 3 then
					prompt = false
				elseif result == 4 or result == -1 then
					break
				end
				if result ~= 2 then
					e:setElementField( 'Map Name', newName )
					changeCount = changeCount+1
				end
			else
				e:setElementField( 'Map Name', newName )
				changeCount = changeCount+1
			end
		else
			WriteError( e, newName )
		end
	end
end
if errCount > 0 then
	local p = ' elements '
	if errCount == 1 then p = ' element ' end
	Alert( 'The map field of '..errCount..p..'could not be changed.\nSee the warnings file for details.' )
end
local p = ' elements were '
if changeCount == 1 then p = ' element was ' end
Alert( changeCount..p..'changed.' )
PopDrawingEnabled()

-- dynamic descriptions must be placed at the end of file
function dynamic_description()
	local description = 'This utility will add a prefix to the beginning of the map field of '..
		'every element in the selection set.  You will be prompted to enter '..
		'the prefix when the utility begins.  If a new map field would exceed '..
		'the '..GetMapNumberLength()..' character limit, it will not be renamed.'
	return description
end

artifacts.source:
-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Rename By Grid Location.lua 
--   Version      : WindMil 8.1
--   Input        : Selection set
--   Return       : Number of elements modified
--   Description  : Rename every selected element based on its location in the currently defined grid.
--   Customer     : None
-- END DESCRIPTION

if not IsUsingGridBasedNaming() then do return end end

-- keep track of element renaming
local OLD_NAMES = {}      -- stores original names (used for output so failures are removed)
local NEW_NAMES = {}      -- stores new grid based names (if one exists)
local FAILED_RENAME = {}  -- stores failed elements
local ORIGINAL_NAMES = {} -- stores original names for failed elements
local RENAMED_SWITCH = {} -- specifically to handle switch/partner issue

local changeCount = 0
local errCount = 0

function GetOldName( e )
	local currName = e:name()
	if OLD_NAMES[e:getGUID()] then
		return OLD_NAMES[e:getGUID()]
	end
	return currName
end

function WriteEmptyError( e, i )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename By Grid Location.lua', errCode = 2, message = GetOldName( e )..
					' could not be renamed (it may lie outside the grid).', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
	FAILED_RENAME[errCount] = e
	ORIGINAL_NAMES[errCount] = OLD_NAMES[e:getGUID()]
	OLD_NAMES[e:getGUID()] = nil
end

function WriteNameError( e, newName, i )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename By Grid Location.lua', errCode = 2, message = GetOldName( e )..
					' could not be renamed to '..newName..' (it may be too long).', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
	FAILED_RENAME[errCount] = e
	ORIGINAL_NAMES[errCount] = OLD_NAMES[e:getGUID()]
	OLD_NAMES[e:getGUID()] = nil
end

function AdjustForSwitchName( e, partnerName )
	local A = '-A'
	local B = '-B'
	local eName = e:name()
	-- escape the '-' and find at end of name
	if partnerName:find( '%'..A..'$' ) then return B end -- presume partner has already been renamed
	if partnerName:find( '%'..B..'$' ) then return A end
	if eName:find( '%'..A..'$' ) then return A end
	if eName:find( '%'..B..'$' ) then return B end
	return A
end

function GenerateUniqueName( name )
	if not name or name == '' then return '' end
	local numStart, numEnd = name:find( '%d+' )
	local unique = tonumber( name:sub( numStart, numEnd ) )
	local prefix, suffix = '', ''
	if numStart ~= 1 then
		prefix = name:sub( 1, numStart-1 )
	end
	if numEnd ~= #name then
		suffix = name:sub( numEnd+1 )
	end
	unique = unique+1
	return prefix..tostring( unique )..suffix
end

function ChangeName( e, newName, i )
	if newName == e:name() then return end
	local result = e:setName( newName )
	if not result then 
		WriteNameError( e, newName, i )
	else
		NEW_NAMES[e:getGUID()] = newName
		changeCount = changeCount+1
	end
end

function FixFailed()
	for i, e in ipairs( FAILED_RENAME ) do
		local originalName = ORIGINAL_NAMES[i]
		if originalName and originalName ~= '' then
			e:setName( ORIGINAL_NAMES[i] )
		end
	end
end

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
for i, e in ipairs( t ) do
	local newName = '^G'..e:name()
	OLD_NAMES[e:getGUID()] = e:name()
	e:setName( newName )
end

local prompt = GetGridEditPromptStatus()
for i=#t,1,-1 do
	local e = t[i]
	local oldName = GetOldName( e )
	if e:name() ~= oldName then
		e:setName( oldName )
	end
	local newName = ''
	if e:elementType() == 'Switch' then
		repeat
			if RENAMED_SWITCH[e:name()] then
				newName = RENAMED_SWITCH[e:name()]
				do break end
			end
			-- must do both sides together or they will not match
			local partner = e:getSwitchPartner()
			local partnerName = ''
			if partner then partnerName = partner:name() end
			newName = e:getGridName( partnerName )
			if partner then
				partnerName = newName..AdjustForSwitchName( partner, e:name() )
			end
			newName = newName..AdjustForSwitchName( e, partnerName )
			-- grid based name may still have a collision once we add suffixes
			while ElementExists( newName ) or ( partner and ElementExists( partnerName ) ) do
				newName = GenerateUniqueName( newName )
				partnerName = GenerateUniqueName( partnerName )
			end
			if partner then
				RENAMED_SWITCH[ GetOldName( partner ) ] = partnerName -- will rename when we find this switch
			end
		until true
	else
		newName = e:getGridName()
	end
	if not newName or newName == '' then
		WriteEmptyError( e, i )
	else
		if prompt then
			local result = MultipleChoice( e:name()..' will be renamed to '..newName..'.', 
						{'Change', 'Skip', 'Change All', 'Skip All'} )
			if result == 3 then
				prompt = false
			elseif result == 4 or result == -1 then
				break
			end
			if result ~= 2 then
				ChangeName( e, newName, i )
			end
		else
			ChangeName( e, newName, i )
		end
	end
end
local fileExName = GetModelPath()..'grid_renamed.txt'
local fileExport = assert( io.open( fileExName, 'w' ), 'Failed to open grid_renamed.txt' )
for guid, oldName in pairs( OLD_NAMES ) do
	local newName = NEW_NAMES[guid]
	if newName then
		fileExport:write( oldName..','..newName..'\n' )
	end
end
fileExport:close()

FixFailed() -- just in case

if errCount > 0 then
	local p = ' elements '
	if errCount == 1 then p = ' element ' end
	Alert( errCount..p..'could not be renamed.\nSee the warnings file for details.' )
end
local p = ' elements were '
if changeCount == 1 then p = ' element was ' end
Alert( changeCount..p..'changed.' )

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : iterators.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.0
--   Input        : determined by function
--   Return       : determined by function
--   Description  : This script contains useful iterators
--   Customer     : None
-- END DESCRIPTION

--[[

	Iterators:
	----------

	1. iterator( iter, elem )
		Params: iterator type {preorder, postorder, breadthfirst}, and element
		Return: ordered elements	
	2. iterate( iter )
		Params: iterator type {mapPoint, section, all}
		Return: all items of that type
	3. filter( filterBy )
		Params: item to filter by {Source, Overhead, Underground, Regulator, Transformer, 
				Switch, Capacitor, Device, Node, Generator, Motor, Consumer, Pole, Tower, 
				Surface Structure, Vault, PullBox, Foreign Structure, Marker, Light}
		Return: all items of that type
		
]]--

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

List = {}
function List.new()
	return { first = 0, last = -1 }
end

function List.push_front( list, value )
	local first = list.first - 1
	list.first = first
	list[ first ] = value
	return value
end

function List.push_back( list, value )
	local last = list.last + 1
	list.last = last
	list[ last ] = value
	return value
end

function List.pop_front( list )
	local first = list.first
	if ( first > list.last ) then return nil end
	local value = list[ first ]
	list[ first ] = nil
	list.first = first + 1
	return value
end

function List.pop_back( list )
	local last = list.last
	if ( list.first > last ) then return nil end
	local value = list[ last ]
	list[ last ] = nil
	list.last = last - 1
	return value
end

function List.empty( list )
	return ( list.first > list.last )
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function iterator( iter, element )
	return coroutine.wrap( function () 
		iter( element ) 
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end )
end	

function preorder( element )
    local child
	coroutine.yield( element )
	for _, child in next, element:children() do
		preorder( child )
	end
end

function postorder( element )
    local child
	for _, child in next, element:children() do
		postorder( child )
	end
	coroutine.yield( element )
end

function breadthfirst( element )
    local child
	local q = List.new()
	List.push_back( q, element )
	while not List.empty( q ) do
        element = List.pop_front( q )
		coroutine.yield( element )
		for _, child in next, element:children() do
			List.push_back( q, child )
		end
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function mapPoint()
	SelectAll()
    local t = MapPoint.getCurrentSelectionSet()
	DeselectAll()
	
    return t
end

function section()
	SelectAll()
    local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
	DeselectAll()
	
    return t
end

function all()
	SelectAll()
    local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
	DeselectAll()
	
    return t
end

function iterate( iter )
    local t = iter()
	return coroutine.wrap( function () 
		getAll( t ) 
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end )
end	

function getAll( t )
	for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
		coroutine.yield( e )
	end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function find( eType )
	SelectAll()
    local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
	DeselectAll()	
    local i = 1
  
	while t[ i ] do
        if t[ i ]:elementType() ~= eType then
            table.remove( t, i )
        else
            i = i + 1
        end
	end

    return t
end

function filter( filterBy )
    local t = find( filterBy )
	return coroutine.wrap( function () 
		getAll( t ) 
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end )
end

--   Description  : This script detects when an external unit table is missing records.

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		GLOBAL VARIABLES
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dofile( '..\\Model Integrity\\Common\\Model Integrity Library Globals.lua' ) -- common globals used for manual file run

local missingRecCount = 0
local missingSet = {}
local extraRecCount = 0
local extraSet = {}

		ERROR REPORTING FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function WriteMissingError( e, status, rowCount, numMissing )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Detect Missing External Units.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'The element '..e:name()..' is '..status..', but has '..rowCount..' record(s).', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	missingRecCount = missingRecCount+numMissing
	table.insert( missingSet, e )
end

function WriteTooManyWarning( e, status, rowCount, numExtra )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Detect Missing External Units.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = 'The element '..e:name()..' is '..status..', but has '..rowCount..' record(s).', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	extraRecCount = extraRecCount+math.abs( numExtra )
	table.insert( extraSet, e )
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		LIBRARY FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function getSingleOrThreeStatusString( num )
	if num == 0 then return 'using balanced single phase equipment' end
	if num == 1 then return 'using unbalanced single phase equipment' end
	if num == 2 then return 'using three phase equipment' end
	if num == 3 then return 'using three winding equipment' end
	return 'using unknown equipment'
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function SetStatusBasedOnWinding( e, status, statusCount )
	local winding = e:getElementField( 'Winding Connection' )
	if winding == 'Y-D open' or winding == 'D-D open' then
		status = 'a delta open transformer'
		statusCount = 2
	elseif winding == 'Y-D one' or winding == 'D-D one' then
		status = 'a delta one transformer'
		statusCount = 1
	elseif winding == 'Y-Y-D Grd' or winding == 'Y-Y-Y Grd' or winding == 'D-Y-D' or winding == 'D-D-D' then
		status = 'a 3-winding transformer'
		statusCount = 1
	end
	return status, statusCount
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local extTable
local message = 'What is the name of your unit table (SQL name)?'
repeat
	local extTableName = PromptString( message, '' )
	if not extTableName then do return end end
	extTable = ExternalTable.getTableFromName( extTableName )
	message = 'INVALID TABLE NAME - please enter the SQL table name'
until extTable

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
DeselectAll()
PurgeErrorLog()
local readExternals = require( 'Scripts.Model Integrity.Common.Read Externals' )
local tableUses = readExternals.GetTableUses( extTable )

local selectDeviceType = require( 'Scripts.Model Integrity.Common.Select Device Type' )
local selectConsumerType = require( 'Scripts.Model Integrity.Common.Select Consumer Type' )
CreateProgressBar( 'Checking external records...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	local eType = e:elementType()
	for __, tableUse in ipairs( tableUses ) do
		repeat
			if eType ~= tableUse then do break end end
			if eType == 'Device' and not selectDeviceType.IsSelectedType( e ) then do break end end
			if eType == 'Consumer' and not selectConsumerType.IsSelectedType( e ) then do break end end
			-- compare phasing to the number of records on the unit table
			local status = e:getElementField( 'Phasing' )
			local statusCount = #status

			-- only expect one record for pad mount transformers
			if eType == 'Transformer' and e:getElementField( 'Is Pad Mount' ) then
				status = 'pad mount'
				statusCount = 1
			end
			-- only expect record counts to match internal transformer phasing
			if eType == 'Transformer' then
				status, statusCount = SetStatusBasedOnWinding( e, status, statusCount )
			end
			-- only expect one record for three phase or three winding transformers
			repeat
				if eType ~= 'Transformer' then do break end end
				local eq = Equipment.getEquipmentFromName( e:getElementField( 'Transformer Impedance' ) )
				if not eq then do break end end
				local transType = eq:getEquipmentField( 'SingleOrThree' )
				-- 0 = balanced single, 1 = unbalanced single
				if not transType or transType <= 1 then do break end end
				status = getSingleOrThreeStatusString( transType )
				statusCount = 1
			until true
			-- only expect one record for three phase controlled by phase regulators
			if eType == 'Regulator' and e:getElementField( 'Regulator Phasing' ) == 'Dependent' then
				status = 'three phase controlled by phase'
				statusCount = 1
			end

			local rows = extTable:getRowsForGuid( e:getGUID() )
			-- only one side of a switch contains records (so ignore this side if the other is valid)
			if eType == 'Switch' and #rows == 0 then
				local partner = e:getSwitchPartner()
				if partner and #extTable:getRowsForGuid( partner:getGUID() ) > 0 then do break end end
			end

			local numMissing = statusCount - #rows
			if numMissing > 0 then WriteMissingError( e, status, #rows, numMissing )
			elseif numMissing < 0 then WriteTooManyWarning( e, status, #rows, numMissing ) end
		until true
	end
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()

-- GENERAL OUTPUT INFORMATION
local output = require( 'Scripts.Model Integrity.Common.Output' )
CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME = extTable:name()..' Missing Records' -- used for report and set name
output.WriteReport( missingSet, {} --[[fields]] )
output.CreateSelectionSet( missingSet )
CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME = extTable:name()..' Extra Records' -- used for report and set name
output.WriteReport( extraSet, {} --[[fields]] )
output.CreateSelectionSet( extraSet )

print( extTable:name()..' results:\n' )
print( '======================================\n' )
output.PrintCount( missingSet, 'element(s) with '..missingRecCount..' missing record(s)' --[[message]] )
output.PrintCount( extraSet, 'element(s) with '..extraRecCount..' extra record(s)' --[[message]] )
if missingRecCount > 0 or extraRecCount > 0 then
	print( '\nSee the warning log for details.\n' )
end

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Find Duplicates.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2.0
--   Input        : None
--   Return       : Writes detailed files containing duplicate information
--   Description  : This script finds duplicate elements of various types:
--                  - Exact Duplicate file contains exact duplicates (not allowed by our system) and how many exist
--                  - Renamed Duplicate file contains all .# elements (can break compatibility with other products)
--                  - Allowed Duplicate file contains duplicate map points across types (not always done purposely)
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		GLOBAL VARIABLES
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS
local ENFORCE_DOT_LENGTH = 3                                  -- only check .# less than or equal to this length 
                                                              -- (comment out or set to nil/false to remove limit)
local exactPath = GetModelPath().. 'Duplicates - Exact.csv'   -- file name for exact duplicate
local renamePath = GetModelPath()..'Duplicates - Renamed.csv' -- file name for renamed duplicate
local allowPath = GetModelPath().. 'Duplicates - Allowed.csv' -- file name for allowed duplicate
-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS

local exactCount = 0
local renameCount = 0
local allowCount = 0

local SECTIONS = {}
local MAP_POINTS = {}

local POINT_TYPES =
	{
		'Pole',
		'Tower',
		'Pad',
		'Pedestal',
		'Junction Box',
		'Enclosure',
		'Vault',
		'PullBox',
		'Foreign Structure',
		'Marker',
		'Light',
		'Surface Structure',
		'Storage Location',
		'Non-Utility Facility'
	}

local exactFile = assert( io.open( exactPath, 'w+' ), 'Exact Duplicates file not found or not accessible for writing.' )
local renameFile = assert( io.open( renamePath, 'w+' ), 'Renamed Duplicates file not found or not accessible for writing.' )
local allowFile = assert( io.open( allowPath, 'w+' ), 'Allowed Duplicates file not found or not accessible for writing.' )

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		SCRIPT MAIN FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function FindExactDuplicates( searchTable )
	for name, subTable in pairs( searchTable ) do
		if type( subTable ) == 'table' and #subTable > 1 then
			exactFile:write( name, ',', #subTable, '\n' )
			exactCount = exactCount+1
		end
	end
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
DeselectAll()

exactFile:write( 'Element Name,Duplicate Count\n' )
renameFile:write( 'Element Name,Element Type\n' )
allowFile:write( 'Element Name,Element Type,Duplicate Type\n' )

CreateProgressBar( 'Searching for duplicates...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
    local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType == '' then eType = 'Switchgear' end
	local isSection = (e:getElementField( 'Map Point Name' ) == nil)

	local eName = e:name()
	-- look for renamed .# duplicates
	local start, finish = eName:find( '%.%d+$' ) -- .# at end of string
	if start and ( not ENFORCE_DOT_LENGTH or finish - start <= ENFORCE_DOT_LENGTH ) then
		renameFile:write( eName, ',', eType, '\n' )
		renameCount = renameCount+1
	end
	-- look for allowed duplicates
	if isSection then
		local subTable = MAP_POINTS[eName]
		if subTable then
			allowFile:write( eName, ',', eType, ',', subTable[1]:elementType(), '\n' )
			allowCount = allowCount+1
		end
	else
		local subTable = SECTIONS[eName]
		if subTable then
			allowFile:write( eName, ',', eType, ',', subTable[1]:elementType(), '\n' )
			allowCount = allowCount+1
		else
			for _, pType in ipairs( POINT_TYPES ) do
				repeat
					if pType == eType then do break end end
					local subTable = MAP_POINTS[eName..' '..pType]
					if not subTable then do break end end
					allowFile:write( eName, ',', eType, ',', subTable[1]:elementType(), '\n' )
					allowCount = allowCount+1
				until true
			end
		end
	end
	-- add names to tables for tracking
	if isSection then
		local subTable = SECTIONS[eName]
		if not subTable then subTable = {} end
		table.insert( subTable, e )
		SECTIONS[eName] = subTable
	else
		local subTable = MAP_POINTS[eName..' '..eType]
		if not subTable then subTable = {} end
		table.insert( subTable, e )
		MAP_POINTS[eName..' '..eType] = subTable
		-- also track just name for allowed file (but only store one to avoid conflict with exact file)
		local singleEntry = MAP_POINTS[eName]
		if not singleEntry then
			MAP_POINTS[eName] = {e}
		end
	end
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()

renameFile:flush()
renameFile:close()
allowFile:flush()
allowFile:close()

-- Exact Duplicates Output --
FindExactDuplicates( SECTIONS )
FindExactDuplicates( MAP_POINTS )

exactFile:flush()
exactFile:close()

-- General Info Output --
if exactCount ~= 0 or renameCount ~= 0 or allowCount ~= 0 then
	print( exactCount..' exact duplicate(s) found.\n' )
	print( renameCount..' renamed duplicate(s) found.\n' )
	print( allowCount..' allowed duplicate(s) found.\n' )
	print( 'Search complete: see files inside your .wm folder for results\n' )
else
	print( 'No duplicates found at this time.\n' )
end

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2.0
--   Input        : None  
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log  
--   Description  : This utility finds switches with invalid parent and child relationships and corrects them.
--                  This script can also help identify partner-less switches and switches that have no effect.
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

local errCount = 0
local warningCount = 0
local manualFixCount = 0
local changeCount = 0

function WriteError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Unable to remove invalid parent from '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 2,
					message = 'Parent corrected to allow switch to operate properly.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function WriteUnusedChildError( e, switch )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Child of '..switch:name()..' is not being used.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	warningCount = warningCount+1
end

function WriteDoubleChildError( e, child )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Switch and partner have identical child '..child:name()..'. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function WriteDoubleParentError( e, parent )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Switch and partner have identical parent '..parent:name()..'. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function WriteUnusedSwitchError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Switch is missing parent and children, so it has no effect. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function WriteHalfPartnerError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Only one side of this switch is partnered. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function WritePartnerlessError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Switch has no partner. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function BaseName( e )
	local name = e:name()
	local partner = e:getSwitchPartner()
	if not partner then return name end -- if partner is invalid, don't prevent other side from being processed too
	-- cut switch suffix out, preserving uniqueness suffix if necessary
	local findStart, findEnd = name:find( '-A' )
	if findStart then
		name = name:sub( 1, findStart-1 )..name:sub( findEnd+1 )
	end
	findStart, findEnd = name:find( '-B' )
	if findStart then
		name = name:sub( 1, findStart-1 )..name:sub( findEnd+1 )
	end
	return name
end

function ReparentChildren( children, parent, switch )
	for _, c in ipairs( children ) do
		-- catch common case of child being an unused line
		local childs = c:children()
		if #childs == 0 then
			WriteUnusedChildError( c, switch )
		end
		-- correct bad parenting
		local result = c:disconnect()
		result = result and c:connect( parent )
		if not result then WriteError( c )
		else WriteMessage( c ) end
	end
end

function NullifyParent( e )
	if not e:disconnect() then WriteError( e )
	else WriteMessage( e ) end
end

function CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( switchParent, switchChildren, switch, hasAlreadyReported )
	if hasAlreadyReported then return true end
	if not switchParent and #switchChildren == 0 then
		WriteUnusedSwitchError( switch )
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function CalculateSwitchData( switch )
	local root = Model.rootElement()
	local switchParent = switch:parent()
	if switchParent:getGUID() == root:getGUID() then
		switchParent = nil
	end
	local partner = switch:getSwitchPartner()
	local partnerChildren = {} -- return an empty table for iterating over
	local partnerParent
	if partner then
		partnerChildren = partner:children()
		partnerParent = partner:parent()
		if partnerParent:getGUID() == root:getGUID() then
			partnerParent = nil
		end
	end
	return switch:children(), switchParent, partner, partnerChildren, partnerParent
end

function FixSwitchParentAndChildIssues( switch )
	-- parent's returned as nil instead of ADAM to prevent trying to fix disconnected switches
	local switchChildren, switchParent, partner, partnerChildren, partnerParent = CalculateSwitchData( switch )

	-- if partner-less switches exist, don't attempt to fix
	if not partner then
		WritePartnerlessError( switch )
		return
	end
	if not partner:getSwitchPartner() then
		WriteHalfPartnerError( partner )
		return
	end

	-- if switch is unused (missing parent and children), still fix it, but make note
	local isSwitchUnused = CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( switchParent, switchChildren, switch )
	local isPartnerUnused = CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( partnerParent, partnerChildren, partner )

	-- check this late to allow script to allow detecting other switch-related issues for all switches
	if switch:getElementField( 'Switch Status' ) == 'Closed' then
		return
	end

	-- fix switch behaving as if it is closed (partner and switch are parent and child)
	if switchParent and switchParent:getGUID() == partner:getGUID() then
		NullifyParent( switch )
		switchChildren, switchParent, partner, partnerChildren, partnerParent = CalculateSwitchData( switch )
	end
	if partnerParent and partnerParent:getGUID() == switch:getGUID() then
		NullifyParent( partner )
		switchChildren, switchParent, partner, partnerChildren, partnerParent = CalculateSwitchData( switch )
	end

	-- check for unused switches again after potentially removing relationships
	isSwitchUnused = CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( switchParent, switchChildren, switch, isSwitchUnused )
	isPartnerUnused = CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( partnerParent, partnerChildren, partner, isPartnerUnused )

	-- report identical parent or identical children, but don't attempt to fix
	if switchParent and partnerParent and switchParent:getGUID() == partnerParent:getGUID() then
		WriteDoubleParentError( switch, switchParent )
		return
	end
	for _, child1 in ipairs( switchChildren ) do
		for __, child2 in ipairs( partnerChildren ) do
			if child1:getGUID() == child2:getGUID() then
				WriteDoubleChildError( switch, child1 )
				return
			end
		end
	end

	-- fix any remaining cases of having both a parent and child
	if #switchChildren > 0 and switchParent then
		ReparentChildren( switchChildren, switchParent, switch )
	end
	if #partnerChildren > 0 and partnerParent then
		ReparentChildren( partnerChildren, partnerParent, partner )
	end

	-- check for unused switches again after potentially removing relationships
	CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( switchParent, switchChildren, switch, isSwitchUnused )
	CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( partnerParent, partnerChildren, partner, isPartnerUnused )
end

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
DeselectAll()

local potentialSwitches = {}
local switchCount = 0

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	if e:elementType() == 'Switch' then
		local name = BaseName( e )
		if not potentialSwitches[name] then
			switchCount = switchCount+1
		end
        potentialSwitches[name] = e -- only store one side of the switch (doesn't matter which side)
	else
		StepProgressBar( 1 )
	end
end

for _, e in pairs( potentialSwitches ) do
	FixSwitchParentAndChildIssues( e )
	StepProgressBar( 2 ) -- assuming no partner-less switches, this will be accurate
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()

if errCount ~= 0 then
	print( errCount..' switch(es) could not be repaired.\n' )
end
if warningCount ~= 0 then
	print( warningCount..' additional warning(s) were discovered.\n' )
end
if manualFixCount ~= 0 then
	print( manualFixCount..' switch(es) require manual correction.\n' )
end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	print( changeCount..' switch(es) have been corrected.\n' )
end
if errCount ~= 0 or warningCount ~= 0 or manualFixCount ~= 0 or changeCount ~= 0 then
	print( 'See the warning log for details.\n' )
else
	print( 'No switches needed to be repaired.' )
end

  local i = 1

  local closestIndex = 1
  while elementArray[i]
  do
    local x, y = GetElementAltLocation( element )
    local x1, y1 = GetElementAltLocation( elementArray[i] )
    local thisDist = math.pow(x-x1,2)+math.pow(y-y1,2)

      closestIndex = i
    end
    i = i + 1

  return elementArray[closestIndex]

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Connect Disconnected Transformers.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2
--   Input        : None
--   Returns      : None
--   Description  : This script connects disconnected transformers to nearby lines
--                  Attempts to find existing points within the threshold, or splits if necessary.
--   Customer     : None
-- END DESCRIPTION

local ROOT_NAME = (Model.rootElement()):name()

local errCount = 0
local changeCount = 0

function distance( x1, y1, x2, y2 )
	return math.sqrt( (x2-x1)*(x2-x1) + (y2-y1)*(y2-y1) )
end

function isLine( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then return true end
	return false
end

function findClosestLine( element )
	local x, y = element:location()
	local elements = Model.getInRadius( x, y, THRESHOLD )
	local closeLine = nil
	local closeDistance = -1
	local closeX, closeY
	for _, e in ipairs( elements ) do
		if isLine( e ) and not e:getElementField( 'In Switchgear' ) then
			local x1, y1 = e:closestPointOnLine( x, y )
			local tempDist = distance( x, y, x1, y1 )
			if closeDistance == -1 or closeDistance > tempDist then
				closeLine = e
				closeDistance = tempDist
				closeX, closeY = x1, y1
			end
		end
	end
	return closeLine, closeX, closeY
end

-- find closest point on line (out of both end points and any existing segments)
function findClosestLinePoint( line, e )
	local xCoords, yCoords = line:getSegmentCoordinates()
	local closePoint = nil
	local closeDistance = -1
	local closeX, closeY
	local eX, eY = e:location()
	for i=1, #xCoords do
		local x, y = xCoords[i], yCoords[i]
		local tempDist = distance( eX, eY, x, y )
		if closeDistance == -1 or closeDistance > tempDist then
			closePoint = i
			closeDistance = tempDist
			closeX, closeY = xCoords[i], yCoords[i]
		end
	end
	return closePoint, closeX, closeY
end

function findParentLine( line )
	local parent = line:parent()
	while parent and parent:name() ~= ROOT_NAME do
		if isLine( parent ) then return parent end
		parent = parent:parent()
	end
	return nil
end

function connect( child, parent )
	local result = child:connect( parent )
	if not result then errCount = errCount+1
	else changeCount = changeCount+1 end
end

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
DeselectAll()

THRESHOLD = PromptString( 'How far do you want to search for a line? (in WindMil units)', 15.0 )
THRESHOLD = tonumber( THRESHOLD )
if not THRESHOLD then t = {} end

CreateProgressBar( 'Checking transformers...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	repeat
		if e:elementType() ~= 'Transformer' or not e:parent() or (e:parent()):name() ~= ROOT_NAME then do break end end
		local closeLine, closeX, closeY = findClosestLine( e )
		if not closeLine then do break end end
		local segIdx, segX, segY = findClosestLinePoint( closeLine, e )
		local x, y = e:location()
		if segIdx and segX and segY and distance( x, y, segX, segY ) < THRESHOLD then  -- closest point is an existing
			local xSegs, ySegs = closeLine:getSegmentCoordinates()
			if segIdx == 1 then
				local parLine = findParentLine( closeLine )
				if parLine then
					connect( e, parLine )
				end
			elseif segIdx == #xSegs then
				connect( e, closeLine )
			else
				closeLine:splitElement( segX, segY )
				connect( e, closeLine )
			end
		elseif closeX and closeY and distance( x, y, closeX, closeY ) < THRESHOLD then -- closest point is a new segment
			closeLine:splitElement( closeX, closeY )
			connect( e, closeLine )
		end
	until true
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()

print( errCount..' transformer(s) failed to connect.\n' )
print( changeCount..' transformer(s) were successfully reconnected.\n' )

--   Input        : None

--   Description  : Splits lines at map points and snap lines
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

local THRESHOLD = 20 -- max distance from map point to line
local SHOW_FAILURE = false -- set to true to display names of poles with a close line that still failed
local SHOW_SUCCESS = false -- set to true to display names of poles that connected

local changeCount = 0
local errCount = 0

function isLine( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then return true end
	return false
end

function distance( x1, y1, x2, y2 )
	return math.sqrt( (x2-x1)*(x2-x1) + (y2-y1)*(y2-y1) )
end

function findClosestMP( x, y )
	local poles = GetMapPointsInRadius( x, y, THRESHOLD )
	local i = 1
	local closePole = nil
	local closeDistance = -1
	local attachedPole = GetMapPointsInRadius( x, y, 0 )
	if #attachedPole ~= 0 then return MapPoint.getMapPointFromNameAndType( attachedPole[i][1], attachedPole[i][2] ) end
	while poles[i] do
		local p = MapPoint.getMapPointFromNameAndType( poles[i][1], poles[i][2] )
		if not p:getAssociated() then
			local x1, y1 = p:location()
			local tempDist = distance( x, y, x1, y1 )
			if closeDistance == -1 or closeDistance > tempDist then
				closePole = p
				closeDistance = tempDist
			end
		end
		i = i+1
	end
	return closePole
end

function findClosestLine( p )
	local x, y = p:location()
	local elements = GetElementsInRadius( x, y, THRESHOLD )
	local i = 1
	local closeLine = nil
	local closeDistance = -1
	local closeX, closeY
	while elements[i] do
		local e = Model.getElementFromName( elements[i] )
		if isLine( e ) then
			local x1, y1 = e:closestPointOnLine( x, y )
			local lineX, lineY = e:location()
			local tempDist = distance( x, y, x1, y1 )
			if closeDistance == -1 or closeDistance > tempDist or              -- closest line
			( x1 == lineX and y1 == lineY and closeDistance >= tempDist ) then -- closest endpoint on tie
				closeLine = e
				closeDistance = tempDist
				closeX, closeY = x1, y1
			end
		end
		i = i+1
	end
	return closeLine, closeX, closeY
end

function findClosestSegment( line, p )
	local xCoords = {}
	local yCoords = {}
	xCoords,  yCoords = line:getSegmentCoordinates()
	local closePoint = nil
	local closeDistance = -1
	local closeX, closeY, idx
	local i = 1
	while xCoords[i] do
		local xPole, yPole = p:location()
		local tempDist = distance( xPole, yPole, xCoords[i], yCoords[i] )
		if closeDistance == -1 or closeDistance > tempDist then
			closePoint = i
			closeDistance = tempDist
			closeX, closeY = xCoords[i], yCoords[i]
			idx = i
		end
		i = i+1
	end
    return closeX, closeY, idx
end

local changeCount = 0
PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = MapPoint.getCurrentSelectionSet()
DeselectAll()

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, p in ipairs( t ) do
	local pX, pY = p:location()
	local line, closeX, closeY = findClosestLine( p )
	local lineX, lineY
	if line then lineX, lineY = line:location() end
	if line and ( closeX ~= lineX or closeY ~= lineY ) then -- mp not already on end
		local failed = false
		local segX, segY, segIdx = findClosestSegment( line, p )
		local existDist = distance( pX, pY, segX, segY )     -- closest existing segment
		local newDist = distance( pX, pY, closeX, closeY )   -- closest new point
		local closeP = findClosestMP( segX, segY )           -- closest mp to existing segment
		-- closest point is an existing segment
		if existDist < THRESHOLD and existDist <= newDist and closeP and p:getGUID() == closeP:getGUID() then
			if lineX ~= segX and lineY ~= segY then          -- closest is not end point
				line:splitElement( segX, segY )
			end
			line:setLocation( pX, pY )
		-- closest point is a new point
		elseif newDist < THRESHOLD then
			line:splitElement( closeX, closeY )
			line:setLocation( pX, pY )
		-- closest does not exist
		else
			if SHOW_FAILURE then print( line:name()..' failed to split or connect.\n' ) end
			failed = true
			errCount = errCount+1
		end
		if not failed then changeCount = changeCount+1 end
		if SHOW_SUCCESS then print( line:name()..' has been split and/or moved.\n' ) end
	end
    StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()

local elems = 'lines'
local have = 'have'
if changeCount == 1 then
	elems = 'line'
	have = 'has'
end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	print( changeCount..' '..elems..' '..have..' been split and/or moved.' )
else
	print( 'No lines needed to be split and/or moved.' )
end
PopDrawingEnabled()

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Unstacking from Map Points.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2
--   Input        : None
--   Return       : Prints the number of changes and/or errors
--   Description  : This script finds things that are stacked on-top of allowed map points
--                  and adjusts them to a more appropriate location (based on nearby line information)
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		GLOBAL VARIABLES
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Location is where a leader line points or line end point is
-- Alt Location is where the symbol is drawn or line starts

-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS
local MOVE_DIST = 0.000020     -- distance to move elements
local SEARCH_RADIUS = 0.00001  -- distance to search for a stack
local OFFSET = MOVE_DIST*0.5   -- distance to offset elements that fall on the same line
local ALIGN_CLOSE = false      -- align with closest (parent or child line) or ALIGN_DOWN in case of ties
local ALIGN_DOWN = true        -- align with downline element (true) or upline element (false)
local STACK_LOC = false        -- elements stacked at location (true) or alt location (false)
local CURR_SEL = false         -- current selection set (true) or select all (false)
local ALLOWED_TYPE =           -- a table of element types to move
	{                          -- commented out types (those with -- in front) will not be moved
--		'Consumer',
		'Transformer',
		'Device',
--		'Node',
		'Motor',
		'Generator',
		'Capacitor',
--		'Switch',
		'Regulator'
	}
local ALLOWED_POINT_TYPE =     -- a table of map point types to move elements from
	{                          -- commented out types (those with -- in front) will not have elements moved from them
		'Pole',
		'Tower',
		'Pad',
		'Pedestal',
		'Junction Box',
		'Enclosure',
		'Vault',
		'PullBox',
		'Foreign Structure',
		'Marker',
		'Light',
		'Surface Structure',
		'Storage Location',
		'Non-Utility Facility'
	}
-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS

-- Other variables used by the script
local GROUPED_ELEMENTS = {}    -- stores elements at a single map point indexed by a nearby line
local SMALL_NUM = 0.00000001   -- used for values close to 0 in calculations
local changeCount = 0          -- count variable for information output

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		LIBRARY FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function distance( x1, y1, x2, y2 )
	return math.sqrt( (x2-x1)*(x2-x1) + (y2-y1)*(y2-y1) )
end

function allowableType( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	for i=1, #ALLOWED_TYPE do
		if ALLOWED_TYPE[i] == eType and not e:getElementField( 'In Switchgear' ) then return true end
	end
	return false    
end

function allowablePointType( p )
	local pType = p:pointType()
	for i=1, #ALLOWED_TYPE do
		if ALLOWED_POINT_TYPE[i] == pType then return true end
	end
	return false    
end

function isLine( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then return true end
	return false
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		HELPER FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function findFirstDownlineLine( e )
	local children = e:children()
	local line = nil
	while #children ~= 0 and not line do
		local tempChildren = {}
		for _, child in ipairs( children ) do
			if isLine( child ) then
				line = child
				break
			else
				local currChildren = child:children()
				for _, c in ipairs ( currChildren ) do
					table.insert( tempChildren, c )
				end
			end
		end
		children = tempChildren
	end
	return line
end

function findFirstUplineLine( e )
	local parent = e:parent()
	while parent and not isLine( parent ) do
		parent = parent:parent()
	end
	return parent
end

function groupElements( key, value )
	if not key then return end
	local subTable = GROUPED_ELEMENTS[key]
	if subTable then
		subTable.insert( value )
		GROUPED_ELEMENTS[key] = subTable
	else
		GROUPED_ELEMENTS[key] = {value}
	end
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function GetNearbyElements( p )
	local x, y = p:location()
	local elements = {}
	local possibleElems = Model.getInRadius( x, y, SEARCH_RADIUS )
	for _, e in ipairs( possibleElems ) do
		if allowableType( e ) then
			local eX, eY = e:location()
			if not STACK_LOC then
				eX, eY = e:altLocation()
			end
			if distance( eX, eY, x, y ) < SEARCH_RADIUS then
				table.insert( elements, e )
			end
		end
	end
	return elements
end

function GroupElements( elements )
	GROUPED_ELEMENTS = {}
	for _, e in ipairs( elements ) do
		repeat
			if ALIGN_CLOSE then
				local dLine = findFirstDownlineLine( e )
				local uLine = findFirstUplineLine( e )
				if dLine and uLine then
					local x, y = e:location()
					if not STACK_LOC then
						x, y = e:altLocation()
					end
					local dX, dY = dLine:findClosestPointOnLine( x, y )
					local uX, uY = uLine:findClosestPointOnLine( x, y )
					local distD = distance( dX, dY, x, y )
					local distU = distance( uX, uY, x, y )
					if distD < distU then
						groupElements( dLine, e )
						do break end
					elseif distU < distD then
						groupElements( uLine, e )
						do break end
					-- else flow into ALIGN_DOWN check
					end
				-- else flow into ALIGN_DOWN check
				end
			end
			if ALIGN_DOWN then
				groupElements( findFirstDownlineLine( e ), e ) 
			else
				groupElements( findFirstUplineLine( e ), e )
			end
		until true
	end
end

function MoveElement( e, line, offset )
	if not offset then offset = 0 end
	local startX, startY, endX, endY
	local x, y = e:location()
	local lineX, lineY = line:location()
	local lineAX, lineAY = line:altLocation()
	local segX, segY = line:getSegmentCoordinates()
	if #segX < 2 or #segY < 2 then return end
	if distance( lineX, lineY, x, y ) < distance( lineAX, lineAY, x, y ) then
		startX, startY = lineX, lineY
		endX, endY = segX[#segX-1], segY[#segY-1]
	else
		startX, startY = lineAX, lineAY
		endX, endY = segX[2], segY[2]
	end
	local dist = distance( startX, startY, endX, endY )
	if dist == 0 then dist = SMALL_NUM end
	local newX = startX + ( MOVE_DIST/dist )*( endX - startX )
	local newY = startY + ( MOVE_DIST/dist )*( endY - startY )
	e:forceSetAltLocation( newX, newY )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function MoveElements()
	for line, eTable in pairs( GROUPED_ELEMENTS ) do
		if #eTable == 1 then
			MoveElement( eTable[1], line )
		else
			local currOffset = 0
			for mult, e in ipairs( eTable ) do
				MoveElement( e, line, currOffset )
				currOffset = OFFSET + currOffset
			end
		end
	end
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
if not CURR_SEL then SelectAll() end
local t = MapPoint.getCurrentSelectionSet()
if not CURR_SEL then DeselectAll() end

CreateProgressBar( 'Scanning elements and moving them...', #t )
for _, p in pairs( t ) do
	repeat
		if not allowablePointType( p ) then do break end end
		local elements = GetNearbyElements( p )
		if #elements == 0 then do break end end
		GroupElements( elements )
		MoveElements()
	until true
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()

-- GENERAL OUTPUT INFORMATION
local elements = 'elements have'
if changeCount == 1 then elements = 'element has' end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	print( changeCount..' '..elements..' been moved.\n' )
else
	print( 'Nothing needed to be unstacked.\n' )
end

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Unstacking.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2
--   Input        : None
--   Return       : Prints the number of changes and/or errors
--   Description  : This script finds things that are stacked on-top of each other
--                  and rings them out so they can be seen
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		GLOBAL VARIABLES
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- Location is where a leader line points or line end point is
-- Alt Location is where the symbol is drawn or line starts

-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS
local STACK_LOC = true  -- elements stacked at location (true) or alt location (false)
local RING_LOC = true   -- ring around location (true) or alt location (false)
local ONLY_RING = false -- only ring and ignore collisions (true) or use collision detection (false)
local CURR_SEL = false  -- current selection set (true) or select all (false)
local UNPOLE = false    -- moves elements from poles if too close (true) or only rings (false)
local ALLOWED_TYPE =    -- a table of element types to ring
	{                   -- commented out types (those with -- in front) will not be moved
		'Consumer',
--		'Transformer',
		'Device',
		'Node',
		'Motor',
		'Generator',
		'Capacitor',
--		'Switch',
		'Regulator'
	}
local RING_SIZE = 50    -- assumed ring size for checking for best position
local COLLISION_N = 15  -- used to scale count for symbol collisions [within SYMBOL_STACK]
local LEADER_N = 3      -- used to scale count for crossing leader lines
local CLOSE_N = 1       -- used for the base count for nearby elements
-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS

-- Set in main script, change there to customize how ringing is done
local LINE_LENGTH       -- designed to take a rough average line length for determining leader sizes
local MOVE_RADIUS       -- distance to move elements
local SEARCH_RADIUS     -- distance to search for a stack
local SYMBOL_STACK      -- distance between symbols that still qualifies as being stacked
local SYMBOL_RADIUS     -- distance to search for overlapping symbols

-- Prints debug information for testing the script
local DEBUG_BEST_LOC = false
local DEBUG_CHECK_COL = false

-- Other variables used by the script
local ELEMENTS = {}     -- a table for faster element name lookup to reduce script runtime
local changeCount = 0   -- count variable for information output

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MATH FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function distance( x1, y1, x2, y2 )
	return math.sqrt( (x2-x1)*(x2-x1) + (y2-y1)*(y2-y1) )
end

function averageLineLength()
	PushDrawingEnabled( false )
	if not CURR_SEL then SelectAll() end
	local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
	if not CURR_SEL then DeselectAll() end

	local sum = 0
	local numLines = 0
	CreateProgressBar( 'Calculating move distance...', #t )
	for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
		local eType = e:elementType()
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then
			local x, y = e:location()
			local x2, y2 = e:altLocation()
			sum = sum + distance( x, y, x2, y2 )
			numLines = numLines+1
		end
		StepProgressBar( 1 )
	end
	HideProgressBar()
	PopDrawingEnabled()

	if numLines > 0 then
		return sum / numLines
	end
	return 0
end

function round( n, idp )
	local mult = 10^(idp or 2)
	return math.floor( n*mult + 0.5 )/mult
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		LIBRARY FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function allowableType( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	for i=1, #ALLOWED_TYPE do
		if ALLOWED_TYPE[i] == eType and not e:getElementField( 'In Switchgear' ) then return true end
	end
	return false    
end

function isMapPoint( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType == 'Pole' or eType == 'Tower' or eType == 'Pad' or eType == 'Pedestal' or eType == 'Junction Box' or
	eType == 'Enclosure' or eType == 'Vault' or eType == 'PullBox' or eType == 'Foreign Structure' or
	eType == 'Marker' or eType == 'Light' or eType == 'Surface Structure' or eType == 'Storage Location' or
	eType == 'Non-Utility Facility' then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function isLine( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then return true end
	return false
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function checkCollisions( x, y, x2, y2, e )
	local eX, eY = e:location()
	local eX2, eY2 = e:altLocation()

if DEBUG_CHECK_COL then
	if e then print( e:name()..':\n' )
	else print( 'ELEMENT MISSING:\n' ) end
	print( '\t'..x ..', '..y ..', '..x2 ..', '..y2 ..'\n' )
	print( '\t'..eX..', '..eY..', '..eX2..', '..eY2..'\n' )
end

	local dist = distance( x2, y2, eX2, eY2 )
	if dist > SYMBOL_STACK then return COLLISION_N, dist end -- scale count if direct collision
	local crossLoc = (eX2-eX)*(y-eY2) - (eY2-eY)*(x-eX2)
	local crossAltLoc = (eX2-eX)*(y2-eY2) - (eY2-eY)*(x2-eX2)
	if crossLoc*crossAltLoc >= 0 then return CLOSE_N end
	local crossLocE = (x2-x)*(eY-y2) - (y2-y)*(eX-x2)
	local crossAltLocE = (x2-x)*(eY2-y2) - (y2-y)*(eX2-x2)
	if crossLocE*crossAltLocE >= 0 then return CLOSE_N end
	return LEADER_N -- scale count if the leaders cross
end

function findBestNewLocation( e, theta )
	local x, y
	if RING_LOC then x, y = e:location()
	else x, y = e:altLocation() end
	local closestCount = -1
	local closestX, closestY, closestTheta -- track ideal position
	local closestDist = 0                  -- track closest distance element
	local closeTheta = theta               -- track current position
	local dtheta = 2 * math.pi / RING_SIZE -- assume an ideal ring size
	for i=1, RING_SIZE do
		local closeX, closeY =  x + MOVE_RADIUS * math.cos( closeTheta ), y + MOVE_RADIUS * math.sin( closeTheta )

if DEBUG_BEST_LOC then
	print( 'Checking '..e:name()..': '..closeX..', '..closeY..' with '..theta..'\n' )
end

		local elements = Model.getInRadius( closeX, closeY, SYMBOL_RADIUS )
		local elementCount = 0
		local closeDist = SYMBOL_RADIUS+1
		for _, el in ipairs( elements ) do
			if not isMapPoint( el ) and e:getGUID() ~= el:getGUID() then
				local scaledCount, tempDist = checkCollisions( x, y, closeX, closeY, el )
				elementCount = elementCount + scaledCount
				if tempDist and tempDist < closeDist then closeDist = tempDist end
			end
		end
		if not closeDist then closeDist = SYMBOL_RADIUS+1 end -- no collisions or too close elements
		if elementCount < closestCount or ( elementCount == closestCount and closeDist > closestDist ) or closestCount == -1 then
			closestX, closestY, closestTheta = closeX, closeY, closeTheta
			closestDist = closeDist
			closestCount = elementCount
		end
		closeTheta = closeTheta + dtheta
	end
	return closestX, closestY, closestTheta
end

function ring( elements )
	local dtheta = 2 * math.pi / #elements
	local theta = math.pi / 12
	for _, e in ipairs( elements ) do
		if allowableType( e ) then
			local newX, newY = 0, 0
			newX, newY, theta = findBestNewLocation( e, theta )
			--SetElementLocation( e:name(), newX, newY ) -- 8.1.3 compatibility function
			e:forceSetAltLocation( newX, newY )          -- 8.2.0 preferred function
			theta = theta + dtheta
			changeCount = changeCount+1
		end
	end
end

function basicRing( elements, x, y )
	local num_elements = #elements
	if num_elements == 0 then return end
	local dtheta = 2 * math.pi / num_elements
	local theta = math.pi / 12
	for _, e in ipairs( elements ) do
		e:forceSetAltLocation( x + MOVE_RADIUS * math.cos( theta ), y + MOVE_RADIUS * math.sin( theta ) )
		theta = theta + dtheta
		changeCount = changeCount+1
	end
end

function markDone( stackedTable )
	for _, stacked in ipairs( stackedTable ) do
		ELEMENTS[stacked:name()] = 0
	end
end

		MAIN SCRIPT
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS
LINE_LENGTH = averageLineLength()
MOVE_RADIUS = LINE_LENGTH / 5.0    -- optimize for populated areas as sorting is significantly harder there
SEARCH_RADIUS = LINE_LENGTH / 1000 -- should be very small unless adjusting elements that aren't really stacked
SYMBOL_STACK = MOVE_RADIUS / 25.0  -- base on symbol size to prevent overlap
SYMBOL_RADIUS = MOVE_RADIUS / 2.0  -- should be large enough to find elements nearby, without finding original stack
-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
if not CURR_SEL then SelectAll() end
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
if not CURR_SEL then DeselectAll() end

for _, e in ipairs( t ) do ELEMENTS[e:name()] = e end -- populate elements lookup table

CreateProgressBar( 'Scanning elements and moving them...', #t )
for _, e in pairs( ELEMENTS ) do
	if e ~= 0 and allowableType( e ) then
		local x, y
		if STACK_LOC then x, y = e:location()
		else x, y = e:altLocation() end
		local stackedElements = { e }
		local elements = Model.getInRadius( x, y, SEARCH_RADIUS )
		local poles = MapPoint.getInRadius( x, y, SEARCH_RADIUS )
		local minimumStackedSize = 1
		if UNPOLE then
			for __, p in ipairs( poles ) do
				local x1, y1 = p:location()
				if distance( x, y, x1, y1 ) <= SEARCH_RADIUS then
					minimumStackedSize = 0
				end
			end
		end
		for __, el in ipairs( elements ) do
			if not isMapPoint( el ) and not isLine( el ) then
				local x1, y1
				if STACK_LOC then x1, y1 = el:location()
				else x1, y1 = el:altLocation() end
				if distance( x, y, x1, y1 ) <= SEARCH_RADIUS and el:getGUID() ~= e:getGUID() then
					stackedElements[#stackedElements+1] = el
				end
			end
		end
		if #stackedElements > minimumStackedSize then
			if ONLY_RING then
				basicRing( stackedElements, x, y )
			else
				ring( stackedElements )
			end
			markDone( stackedElements )
		end
	end
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()

-- GENERAL OUTPUT INFORMATION

	print( changeCount..' '..elements..' been moved.\n' )
else

					message = 'The element '..eName..' on line '..num..' does not exist.'} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteFloatError( col, num )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Apply Reliability Indexes.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'The value in column '..col..' on line '..num..
					' is not a valid floating-point number.'} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteError( e, rel, relNum )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Apply Reliability Indexes.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = e:name()..' could not change '..rel..' to '..relNum..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( e )

					message = e:name()..' had reliabiliy data applied without issue.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

local fileName = GetModelPath()..'reliability.txt'
local file = io.open( fileName )
if not file then
	fileName = PromptOpenFile( 'Where is your reliability file located?', 'C:\\', 'Text Files (*.txt)|*.txt|CSV Files (*.csv)|*.csv|All Files|*.*' )
	if not fileName or fileName == '' then do return end end
	file = assert( io.open( fileName ), 'File not found.' )
end
io.input( fileName )

local elems = {}
for line in file:lines() do
	local t = {}
	string.gsub( line..",","([^,]*),", function ( x ) table.insert( t, x ) end )
	table.insert( elems, t )
end
file:close()

function CheckNum( num, col, line )
	local result = tonumber( num )
	if not result then
		WriteFloatError( col, line )
		return nil, true
	else
		return result, false
	end
end

function GetCol( num )
	if num == 2 then return 'SAIDI' end
	if num == 3 then return 'SAIFI' end
	if num == 4 then return 'CAIDI' end
	if num == 5 then return 'ASAI'  end
	if num == 6 then return 'ALIDI' end
	if num == 7 then return 'ALIFI' end

    local element  = el[ 1 ]

			local temp
			local num, errored = CheckNum( el[ i ], i, _ )
			if not errored then

				temp = e:setElementField( rel, num )
				if temp ~= num then
					WriteError( e, rel, num )
					failed = true
				end
			else
				failed = true
			end
		end
		if not failed then WriteMessage( e ) end
	end
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end

eles = 'elements'

	Alert( changeCount..' '..eles..' had reliability data successfully applied.\n See the warning log for details.' )
elseif changeCount == 0 and errCount == 0 then
	Alert( 'No elements were changed.' )

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Fix Incorrect Coordinates.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2
--   Input        : Current selection set.  If none selected, selects all.
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log
--   Description  : It ensures that all coordinates and alt-coordinates are in the correct locations so that 
--      WindMil is able to draw a circuit element without requiring any coordinate information from the element's
--      parent.  This utility is perfectly safe to run and can cause no harm to your model.
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

errCount = 0
changeCount = 0
PushDrawingEnabled( false )
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
local selectStr = 'In the current selection set of '..#t..' feature(s),'
if #t == 0 then
	SelectAll()
	t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
	selectStr = 'In the entire model of '..#t..' feature(s),'
	DeselectAll()
end

function WriteManualError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Incorrect Coordinates.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Invalid coordinates on element '..e:name()..
					' (requires manual fix).', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Incorrect Coordinates.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Unable to reposition '..e:name(), GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( e, x, y )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Incorrect Coordinates.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = e:name()..' was repositioned to '..x..', '..y..
					' because its coordinates were garbage.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function isNAN( n )
	if n ~= n or n == nil then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function isMapPoint( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType == 'Pole' or eType == 'Tower' or eType == 'Pad' or eType == 'Pedestal' or eType == 'Junction Box' or
	eType == 'Enclosure' or eType == 'Vault' or eType == 'PullBox' or eType == 'Foreign Structure' or
	eType == 'Marker' or eType == 'Light' or eType == 'Surface Structure' or eType == 'Storage Location' or
	eType == 'Non-Utility Facility' then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function GuessSegmentCoord( startCoord, endCoord, offset, numSegs, currSeg )
	local coordEst
	if startCoord == endCoord then
		coordEst = startCoord
	else
		if not offset then
			coordEst = ( startCoord + endCoord )/2
		else
			if endCoord > startCoord then
				coordEst = startCoord + ( endCoord - startCoord )/( numSegs-1 )*( currSeg-1 )
			else
				coordEst = startCoord - ( startCoord - endCoord )/( numSegs-1 )*( currSeg-1 )
			end
		end
	end

	return coordEst
end

function FindBestXYCoords( e )
	local children = e:children()
	local x, y = e:location()
	for _, c in ipairs( children ) do
		local cType = c:elementType()
		if cType == 'Overhead' or cType == 'Underground' then
			x, y = c:altLocation()
			break
		else
			x, y = c:location()
		end
	end
	return x, y
end

function CheckCoords( coordsFixed, newX, newY, setX, setY, e )
	if newX == setX and newY == setY then
		coordsFixed = coordsFixed and true
	else
		WriteError( e )
		coordsFixed = false
	end
	return coordsFixed
end

function FixElement( e, eType )
	local coordsFixed = 1
	local p = e:parent()
	local x, y = e:location()
	local x2, y2 = e:altLocation()
	local pX, pY  = p:location()

	-- fix invalid coords and alt coords
	if isNAN( x ) or isNAN( y ) then
		local tempX, tempY = e:forceSetLocation( pX, pY )
		coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, pX, pY, e )
		x, y = e:location()
	end
	if isNAN( x2 ) or isNAN( y2 ) then
		local tempX, tempY = e:forceSetAltLocation( pX, pY )
		coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, pX, pY, e )
		x2, y2 = e:altLocation()
	end

	if p:name() ~= 'ADAM!@#$%^&*()_' then
		-- fix incorrect coords and alt coords
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then
			if x2 ~= pX or y2 ~= pY then
				local tempX, tempY = e:forceSetAltLocation( pX, pY )
				coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, pX, pY, e )
				x2, y2 = e:altLocation()
			end
		else
			if x ~= pX or y ~= pY then
				local tempX, tempY = e:forceSetLocation( pX, pY )
				coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, pX, pY, e )
				x, y = e:location()
			end
		end

		-- adjust lines
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then	
			-- ensures no dangling lines and finds better coordinate options than parent location
			if coordsFixed ~= 1 and coordsFixed then
				local endX, endY = FindBestXYCoords( e )
				if x ~= endX or y ~= endY then
					local tempX, tempY = e:forceSetLocation( endX, endY )
					coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, endX, endY, e )
				end
			-- other options for adjusting incorrect lines
			elseif x == pX and y == pY and ( x ~= x2 or y ~= y2 ) then
				local tempX, tempY = e:forceSetLocation( x2, y2 )
				coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, x2, y2, e )
				tempX, tempY = e:forceSetAltLocation( x, y )
				coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, x, y, e )
				-- reverse segments if any exist
				local sX, sY = e:getSegmentCoordinates()
				for i=#sX-1, 2, -1 do -- first and last are location and alt location
					e:setSegmentLocation( #sX-i, sX[i], sY[i] )
				end
			elseif pX ~= x2 or pY ~= y2 then
				local tempX, tempY = e:forceSetAltLocation( pX, pY )
				coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, pX, pY, e )
			end

			-- fix segment coords
			local x3, y3 = e:getSegmentCoordinates()
			local startX, startY = p:location()
			local endX, endY
			local offset = false
			for i=1, #x3 do -- checks begin and end to ensure good coords
				local cX = x3[i]
				if isNAN( cX ) then
					if not isNAN( x3[i+1] ) then
						endX = x3[i+1]
						offset = false
					else
						endX = x
						offset = true
					end
					cX = GuessSegmentCoord( startX, endX, offset, #x3, i )
					e:setSegmentLocation( i, cX, y3[i] )
				end
				startX = cX
			end
			for j=1, #y3 do -- checks begin and end to ensure good coords
				local cY = y3[j]
				if isNAN( cY ) then
					if not isNAN( y3[j+1] ) then
						endY = y3[j+1]
						offset = false
					else
						endY = y
						offset = true
					end
					cY = GuessSegmentCoord( startY, endY, offset, #y3, j )
					e:setSegmentLocation( j, x3[j], cY )
				end
				startY = cY
			end
		-- adjust everything else
		else
			if p:name() == 'ADAM!@#$%^&*()_' then
			-- this should be impossible to hit, but it was included in the original
				if x ~= x2 or y ~= y2 then
					local tempX, tempY = e:forceSetLocation( x2, y2 )
					coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, x2, y2, e )
				end
			elseif x ~= pX or y ~= pY then
				local tempX, tempY = e:forceSetLocation( pX, pY )
				coordsFixed = CheckCoords( coordsFixed, tempX, tempY, pX, pY, e )
			end
		end
	end

	if coordsFixed ~= 1 and coordsFixed then
		local x, y = e:location()
		WriteMessage( e, x, y )
	end
end

function FixMapPoint( e )
	local x, y = e:location()
	if isNAN( x ) or isNAN( y ) then
		local point = MapPoint.getMapPointFromNameAndType( e:name(), e:elementType() )
		if point then -- point name may be longer than currently findable
			local associated = point:getAssociated()
			if not associated then
				WriteManualError( associated )
			else
				local aX, aY = associated:getLocation()
				local tempX, tempY = e:setLocation( aX, aY )
				if tempX == aX and tempY == aY then WriteMessage( e, aX, aY )
				else WriteError( e ) end
			end
		end
	end
end

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType ~= '' and eType ~= 'Switchgear' then -- ignore switchgear points
		if not isMapPoint( e ) then
			FixElement( e, eType )
		else
			FixMapPoint( e )
		end
	end
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
local eles = 'elements'
if errCount == 1 then eles = 'element' end
if errCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( selectStr..'\n'..errCount..' circuit '..eles..' could not be moved.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
end
eles = 'elements'
if changeCount == 1 then eles = 'element' end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( selectStr..'\n'..changeCount..' circuit '..eles..' had garbage coordinates.\n'..
		'Each has been moved to appropriate coordinates.\n'..
		'See the warning log for details.' )
elseif changeCount == 0 and errCount == 0 then
	Alert( selectStr..'\n'..'No elements needed to be fixed.' )
end
PopDrawingEnabled()

function AdjustForCenterTap( phase )
	if phase == 'An' then return 'AB' end
	if phase == 'Bn' then return 'BC' end
	if phase == 'Cn' then return 'AC' end
	return phase
end

function FindPhase( phase )
	local phaseNum = 0
	if string.find( phase, 'A' ) then phaseNum = phaseNum+1 end
	if string.find( phase, 'B' ) then phaseNum = phaseNum+2 end
	if string.find( phase, 'C' ) then phaseNum = phaseNum+4 end
	return phaseNum
end

		parPhase = AdjustForCenterTap( parPhase )
		local phase = e:getElementField( 'Phasing' )
		phase = AdjustForCenterTap( phase )
		if phase == '???' then -- invalidPhase
			local newPhase = FindPhase( parPhase )
			local result = e:rephase( newPhase )
			if not result then WriteError( e )
			else WriteMessage( e, parPhase ) end
		end
	end

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2.0
--   Input        : None  
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log  
--   Description  : This utility finds switches with invalid parent and child relationships and corrects them.
--                  This script can also help identify partner-less switches and switches that have no effect.
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

local errCount = 0
local warningCount = 0
local manualFixCount = 0
local changeCount = 0

function WriteError( e )
    WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
                    message = 'Unable to remove invalid parent from '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( e )
    WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 2,
        message = 'Parent corrected to allow switch to operate properly.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function WriteUnusedChildError( e, switch )
    WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
                    message = 'Child of '..switch:name()..' is not being used.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	warningCount = warningCount+1
end

function WriteDoubleChildError( e, child )
    WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
                    message = 'Switch and partner have identical child '..child:name()..'. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function WriteDoubleParentError( e, parent )
    WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
                    message = 'Switch and partner have identical parent '..parent:name()..'. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function WriteUnusedSwitchError( e )
    WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
                    message = 'Switch is missing parent and children, so it has no effect. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function WriteHalfPartnerError( e )
    WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
                    message = 'Only one side of this switch is partnered. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function WritePartnerlessError( e )
    WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Fix Switch Parent and Child Issues.lua', errCode = 3,
                    message = 'Switch has no partner. Manual fix required.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	manualFixCount = manualFixCount+1
end

function BaseName( e )
	local name = e:name()
	local partner = e:getSwitchPartner()
	if not partner then return name end -- if partner is invalid, don't prevent other side from being processed too
	-- cut switch suffix out, preserving uniqueness suffix if necessary
	local findStart, findEnd = name:find( '-A' )
	if findStart then
		name = name:sub( 1, findStart-1 )..name:sub( findEnd+1 )
	end
	findStart, findEnd = name:find( '-B' )
	if findStart then
		name = name:sub( 1, findStart-1 )..name:sub( findEnd+1 )
	end
	return name
end

function ReparentChildren( children, parent, switch )
	for _, c in ipairs( children ) do
		-- catch common case of child being an unused line
		local childs = c:children()
		if #childs == 0 then
			WriteUnusedChildError( c, switch )
		end
		-- correct bad parenting
		local result = c:disconnect()
		result = result and c:connect( parent )
		if not result then WriteError( c )
		else WriteMessage( c ) end
	end
end

function NullifyParent( e )
    if not e:disconnect() then WriteError( e )
    else WriteMessage( e ) end
end

function CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( switchParent, switchChildren, switch, hasAlreadyReported )
	if hasAlreadyReported then return true end
	if not switchParent and #switchChildren == 0 then
		WriteUnusedSwitchError( switch )
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function CalculateSwitchData( switch )
	local root = Model.rootElement()
	local switchParent = switch:parent()
	if switchParent:getGUID() == root:getGUID() then
		switchParent = nil
	end
	local partner = switch:getSwitchPartner()
	local partnerChildren = {} -- return an empty table for iterating over
	local partnerParent
	if partner then
		partnerChildren = partner:children()
		partnerParent = partner:parent()
		if partnerParent:getGUID() == root:getGUID() then
			partnerParent = nil
		end
	end
	return switch:children(), switchParent, partner, partnerChildren, partnerParent
end

function FixSwitchParentAndChildIssues( switch )
	-- parent's returned as nil instead of ADAM to prevent trying to fix disconnected switches
	local switchChildren, switchParent, partner, partnerChildren, partnerParent = CalculateSwitchData( switch )

	-- if partner-less switches exist, don't attempt to fix
	if not partner then
		WritePartnerlessError( switch )
		return
	end
	if not partner:getSwitchPartner() then
		WriteHalfPartnerError( partner )
		return
	end

	-- if switch is unused (missing parent and children), still fix it, but make note
	local isSwitchUnused = CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( switchParent, switchChildren, switch )
	local isPartnerUnused = CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( partnerParent, partnerChildren, partner )

	-- check this late to allow script to allow detecting other switch-related issues for all switches
	if switch:getElementField( 'Switch Status' ) == 'Closed' then
		return
	end

	-- fix switch behaving as if it is closed (partner and switch are parent and child)
	if switchParent and switchParent:getGUID() == partner:getGUID() then
		NullifyParent( switch )
		switchChildren, switchParent, partner, partnerChildren, partnerParent = CalculateSwitchData( switch )
	end
	if partnerParent and partnerParent:getGUID() == switch:getGUID() then
		NullifyParent( partner )
		switchChildren, switchParent, partner, partnerChildren, partnerParent = CalculateSwitchData( switch )
	end

	-- check for unused switches again after potentially removing relationships
	isSwitchUnused = CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( switchParent, switchChildren, switch, isSwitchUnused )
	isPartnerUnused = CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( partnerParent, partnerChildren, partner, isPartnerUnused )

	-- report identical parent or identical children, but don't attempt to fix
	if switchParent and partnerParent and switchParent:getGUID() == partnerParent:getGUID() then
		WriteDoubleParentError( switch, switchParent )
		return
	end
	for _, child1 in ipairs( switchChildren ) do
		for __, child2 in ipairs( partnerChildren ) do
			if child1:getGUID() == child2:getGUID() then
				WriteDoubleChildError( switch, child1 )
				return
			end
		end
	end

	-- fix any remaining cases of having both a parent and child
	if #switchChildren > 0 and switchParent then
		ReparentChildren( switchChildren, switchParent, switch )
	end
	if #partnerChildren > 0 and partnerParent then
		ReparentChildren( partnerChildren, partnerParent, partner )
	end

	-- check for unused switches again after potentially removing relationships
	CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( switchParent, switchChildren, switch, isSwitchUnused )
	CheckIfSwitchIsUsed( partnerParent, partnerChildren, partner, isPartnerUnused )
end

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
DeselectAll()

local potentialSwitches = {}
local switchCount = 0

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	if e:elementType() == 'Switch' then
		local name = BaseName( e )
		if not potentialSwitches[name] then
			switchCount = switchCount+1
		end
        potentialSwitches[name] = e -- only store one side of the switch (doesn't matter which side)
	else
		StepProgressBar( 1 )
	end
end

for _, e in pairs( potentialSwitches ) do
	FixSwitchParentAndChildIssues( e )
	StepProgressBar( 2 ) -- assuming no partner-less switches, this will be accurate
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()

if errCount ~= 0 then
	print( errCount..' switch(es) could not be repaired.\n' )
end
if warningCount ~= 0 then
	print( warningCount..' additional warning(s) were discovered.\n' )
end
if manualFixCount ~= 0 then
	print( manualFixCount..' switch(es) require manual correction.\n' )
end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	print( changeCount..' switch(es) have been corrected.\n' )
end
if errCount ~= 0 or warningCount ~= 0 or manualFixCount ~= 0 or changeCount ~= 0 then
	print( 'See the warning log for details.\n' )
else
	print( 'No switches needed to be repaired.' )
end
