-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Nullify Invalid Equipment Refs.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2
--   Input        : None
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log
--   Description  : This utility will find all elements that reference non-existent equipment and nullify those 
--      references so that they no longer give errors in analysis. You may want to run this utility if you see 
--      analysis error messages about invalid equipment pointers.
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

errCount = 0
changeCount = 0
PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
DeselectAll()

function WriteMessage( e, eqType )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Nullify Invalid Equipment Refs.lua', errCode = 2,
					message = e:name()..' has invalid '..eqType..' equipment. '..
					'The equipment reference was nullified.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function WriteError( e, eqType )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Nullify Invalid Equipment Refs.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Unable to nullify invalid '..eqType..' equipment '..
					' for '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function FixInvalid( e, eqType )
	local idx = e:getElementField( eqType, true )
	local eqName = e:getElementField( eqType )
	if idx and idx ~= '{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}' and not eqName then
		local result = e:setElementField( eqType, '' )
		local msgType = string.lower( eqType )
		if result ~= '' then WriteError( e, msgType )
		else WriteMessage( e, msgType ) end	
	end
end

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType ~= '' and eType ~= 'Switchgear' then		
		-- check Load Eq
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' or 
				eType == 'Consumer'  or eType == 'Node' then
			FixInvalid( e, 'Load Mix' )
			FixInvalid( e, 'Load Zone' )
		end
		-- check Conductor, Transformer, Regulator and Device Eq
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' or eType == 'Transformer' or
				eType == 'Regulator' or eType == 'Device' then
			for i=65, 67 do
				local phase = string.char( i )
				if eType == 'Overhead' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'OH Conductor '..phase )
				elseif eType == 'Underground' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'UG Conductor '..phase )
				elseif eType == 'Transformer' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'Transformer Impedance '..phase )
				elseif eType == 'Regulator' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'Regulator Equipment '..phase )
				elseif eType == 'Device' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'Device Equipment '..phase )
				end
			end
		end
		-- check Construction, fourth Conductor Eq
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then
			FixInvalid( e, 'Construction' )
			FixInvalid( e, 'Neutral Conductor' )
		end
		-- check Impedance Eq
		if eType == 'Source' then
			FixInvalid( e, 'Min Impedance Code' )
			FixInvalid( e, 'Max Impedance Code' )
		end
		-- Assembly
		local p = MapPoint.getMapPointFromNameAndType( e:name(), eType )
		if p then
			local idxs = p:getAssemblyIndices()
			local guids = p:getAssemblyGUIDs()
			for i, idx in ipairs( idxs ) do
				local eq = Equipment.getAssemblyFromIndex( idx )
				if not eq then
					local result = p:removeAssembly( guids[i] )
					if not result then WriteError( e, 'assembly' )
					else WriteMessage( e, 'assembly' ) end
				end
			end
		end
	end
    StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
local inst = 'instances'
if errCount == 1 then inst = 'instance' end
if errCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( errCount..' '..inst..' of invalid equipment could not be nullified.'..
		'\nSee the warning log for details.' )
end
inst = 'instances'
local were = 'were'
if changeCount == 1 then
	were = 'was'
	inst = 'instance'
end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( changeCount..' '..inst..' of invalid equipment '..were..' nullified.'..
		'\nSee the warning log for details.' )
elseif changeCount == 0 and errCount == 0 then
	Alert( 'No instances of invalid equipment were found.' )
end
PopDrawingEnabled()

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Remove Unnecessary Multiparent Nodes.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.1
--   Input        : None  
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log  
--   Description  : If a multiparent node has one level of bankable parents, and all of its parents are same of 
--      the same bankable type, this utility will replace the multiparent and its parents with one equivalent 
--      banked element.
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

errCount = 0
changeCount = 0
PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
DeselectAll()

function WriteParentError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Remove Unnecessary Multiparent Nodes.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = 'Multiparent node '..e:name()..
					'\'s actual parent not listed as a multiparent.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteRephaseError( e, phase )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Remove Unnecessary Multiparent Nodes.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Unable to rephase '..e:name()..' to '..phase..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteEquipError( e, phase )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Remove Unnecessary Multiparent Nodes.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = e:name()..' is missing equipment on phase '..phase..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteRemoveError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Remove Unnecessary Multiparent Nodes.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Unable to remove '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteConnectError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Remove Unnecessary Multiparent Nodes.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Unable to reparent '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Remove Unnecessary Multiparent Nodes.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = e:elementType()..' '..e:name()..
					' has been banked and it\'s multiparent node child deleted.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function Delete( e )
	local result = e:delete()
	if not result then WriteRemoveError( e ) end
end

function FindFirstValidParent( parents )
	for _, parent in ipairs ( parents ) do
		if parent then return parent end
	end
	return nil
end

function FindPhase( phase )
	local phaseNum = 0
	if string.find( phase, 'A' ) then phaseNum = phaseNum+1 end
	if string.find( phase, 'B' ) then phaseNum = phaseNum+2 end
	if string.find( phase, 'C' ) then phaseNum = phaseNum+4 end
	return phaseNum
end

function Rephase( e, phase )
	local phaseNum = FindPhase( phase )
	local result = e:rephase( phaseNum )
	if not result then WriteRephaseError( e, phase ) end
end

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	if e:elementType() == 'Node' and e:getElementField( 'Multi-Parent Node' ) then
		local parents = e:getMultiparents()
		if #parents ~= 3 then WriteParentError( e )
		else
			-- check if multiparent node is necessary
			local unnecessary = true
			local numMiss = 0
			local commonParentNum = -1
			local pType = FindFirstValidParent( parents ):elementType()
			local parentGUID = ( FindFirstValidParent( parents ):parent() ):getGUID()
			for __, p in ipairs( parents ) do
				if p and ( p:elementType() ~= pType or ( p:parent() ):getGUID() ~= parentGUID or
						#p:getElementField( 'Phasing' ) ~= 1 ) then
					unnecessary = false
					break
				elseif pType == 'Switch' then
					if p:getElementField( 'Switch Status' ) ~= 'Closed' then
						unnecessary = false
						break
					end
					local swtPartner = p:getSwitchPartner()
					if commonParentNum == -1 then commonParentNum = ( swtPartner:parent() ):getGUID()
					elseif commonParentNum ~= ( swtPartner:parent() ):getGUID() then
						unnecessary = false
						break
					end
				elseif pType == 'Device' then
					if commonParentNum == -1 then commonParentNum = ( p:parent() ):getGUID()
					elseif commonParentNum ~= ( p:parent() ):getGUID() then
						unnecessary = false
						break
					end
				else
					numMiss = numMiss+1
				end
			end
			if ( pType ~= 'Device' and pType ~= 'Switch' ) or numMiss > 1 then
				unnecessary = false
			end

			-- remove excess elements and add single element in their place
			if unnecessary then
				local children = e:children()
				local newSingle = FindFirstValidParent( parents )
				local newPhase = e:getElementField( 'Phasing' )
				Rephase( newSingle, newPhase )
				if pType == 'Switch ' then
					local partner = newSingle:getSwitchPartner()
					Rephase( partner, newPhase )
				elseif pType == 'Device' then
					local isSame = true
					local newEq = newSingle:getElementField( 'Device Equipment '..newSingle:getElementField( 'Phasing' ) )
					for i=2, 3 do
						if parents[i] then
							local tempPhase = parents[ i ]:getElementField( 'Phasing' )
							if parents[ i ]:getElementField( 'Device Equipment '..tempPhase ) ~= newEq then
								isSame = false
							end
						end
					end
					newSingle:setElementField( 'All Phases Same', isSame )
					if not isSame then 
						for i=2, 3 do
							if parents[i] then
								local tempPhase = parents[ i ]:getElementField( 'Phasing' )
								local tempEq = parents[ i ]:getElementField( 'Device Equipment '..tempPhase )
								local result = newSingle:setElementField( 'Device Equipment '..tempPhase, tempEq )
								if result ~= tempEq then WriteEquipError( newSingle, tempPhase ) end
							end
						end	
					end
				end
				local parent = e:parent()
				Delete( e )
				for i=1, 3 do
					if parents[i] and parents[i]:getGUID() ~= parent:getGUID() then Delete( parents[i] ) end
				end
				for __, c in ipairs( children ) do
					local result = c:connect( newSingle )
					if not result then WriteConnectError( e ) end
				end
				WriteMessage( newSingle )
			end
		end
	end
    StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
local nodes = 'nodes'
if errCount == 1 then nodes = 'node' end
if errCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( errCount..' multiparent '..nodes..' could not be removed.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
end
nodes = 'nodes were'
if changeCount == 1 then nodes = 'node was' end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( changeCount..' multiparent '..nodes..' removed.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
elseif changeCount == 0 and errCount == 0 then
	Alert( 'It was not necessary to remove any multiparent nodes.' )
end
PopDrawingEnabled()

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Remove Unnecessary Transformers.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.1
--   Input        : None  
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log  
--   Description  : If there is more than one transformer parented to the same element and at least one of those 
--      transformers has children, this utility will remove the childless transformers.  If none of the sibling 
--      transformers have children, all but one of them are removed.
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

errCount = 0
changeCount = 0
PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
DeselectAll()

function WriteError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Remove Unnecessary Transformers.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Unable to remove '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( e, num )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Remove Unnecessary Transformers.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = e:name()..' was bereaved of '..num..
					' transformer sibling(s).', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	local children = e:children()
	local removeCount = 0
	local keepT = 0
	local transCount = 0
	for __, c in ipairs( children ) do
		if c:elementType() == 'Transformer' then
			transCount = transCount+1
		end
	end
	if transCount > 1 then
		for __, c in ipairs( children ) do
			if c:elementType() == 'Transformer' then 
				local cCount = #c:children()
				if cCount ~= 0 then
					keepT = __
				elseif keepT ~= 0 or ( keepT == 0 and __ ~= transCount ) then
					local result = c:delete()
					if not result then WriteError( c )
					else removeCount = removeCount+1 end
				elseif keepT == 0 and __ == #children then
					keepT = __
				end
			end
		end
		if removeCount > 0 then
			local child = e:children()
			WriteMessage( child[1], removeCount )
		end
	end
    StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
local trans = 'transformers'
if errCount == 1 then trans = 'transformer' end
if errCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( errCount..' '..trans..' could not be removed.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
end
trans = 'transformers were'
if changeCount == 1 then trans = 'transformer was' end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( changeCount..' '..trans..' removed.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
elseif changeCount == 0 and errCount == 0 then
	Alert( 'It was not necessary to remove any transformers.' )
end

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Rename Duplicate Elements.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.1
--   Input        : None  
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log  
--   Description  : This utility will scan the WindMil database for duplicate element names.  For each duplicate 
--      name it finds, it will rename it by appending an integer suffix and then write a warning to the warning 
--      log indicating the element that was changed.
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

errCount = 0
changeCount = 0
PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
DeselectAll()

function WriteEmptyError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename Duplicate Elements.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Empty name found for child of '..e:parent()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename Duplicate Elements.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Unable to rename '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( e, oldName )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename Duplicate Elements.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = oldName..' was renamed '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	local name = e:name()
	if not name or string.gsub( name, ' ', '' ) == '' then
		WriteEmptyError( e )
	else
		local testEle = Model.getElementFromName( name )
		if e:getGUID() ~= testEle:getGUID() then
			local suff = 0
			local goodName = false
			local newName = ''
			while not goodName and suff ~= 99 do
				suff = suff+1
				newName = name..'-'..suff
				if #newName > GetSectionNameLength() then
					local newLength = #newName - GetSectionNameLength()

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Rename Elements in File.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.1
--   Input        : rename.txt or similar csv file  
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log
--   Description  : This utility will attempt to open a file called 'rename.txt' in the .wm directory.  This file
--      should contain one or more comma delimited lines that indicate which sections and mappoints to rename and
--      what the new name should be. If a new name already exists, that line will be skipped.
--      Since mappoints can have the same name for different types, a 3rd entry can be included for these lines
--      specifing the type of point (integer or string value).
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

local EOL = 'EndOfLine'
local OLD = 1
local NEW = 2
local TYPE = 3

errCount = 0
changeCount = 0

function WriteMissingError( eName, num )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'The element '..eName..' on line '..num..' does not exist.'} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteSizeError( num )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'New name on line '..num..' exceeds maximum length.'} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteDupError( num )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Old and new names are the same on line '..num..'.'} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteExistError( eName, num )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'The name on line '..num..' ('..eName..') is already in use.'} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Unable to rename '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( old, new, guid )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rename Elements in File.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = old..' was renamed '..new..'.', GUID = guid} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function Rename( e, oldName, newName )
	local result = e:setName( newName )
	if not result then WriteError( e )
	else WriteMessage( oldName, newName, e:getGUID() ) end
end

function RenameSection( e, oldName, newName, lineNum )
	if #newName > GetSectionNameLength() then
		WriteSizeError( lineNum )
		return
	end
	if ElementExists( newName ) then
		WriteExistError( newName, lineNum )
		return
	end
	Rename( e, oldName, newName )
end

function RenameMapPoint( mp, oldName, newName, lineNum )
	if #newName > GetMapPointNameLength() then
		WriteSizeError( lineNum )
		return
	end
	local pointType = mp:pointType()
	if MapPointExists( newName, pointType ) then
		WriteExistError( newName, lineNum )
		return
	end
	Rename( mp, oldName, newName )
end

local fileName = GetModelPath()..'rename.txt'
local file = io.open( fileName )
if not file then
	fileName = PromptOpenFile( 'Where is your rename file located?', 'C:\\', 'Text Files (*.txt)|*.txt|CSV Files (*.csv)|*.csv|All Files|*.*' )
	if not fileName or fileName == '' then do return end end
	file = assert( io.open( fileName ), 'File not found.' )
end
io.input( fileName )

local elems = {}
for line in file:lines() do
	local t = {}
	string.gsub( line..",","([^,]*),", function ( x ) table.insert( t, x ) end )
	table.insert( t, EOL )
	table.insert( elems, t )
end
file:close()

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
local priority, elemPrrty, skipAll
CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #elems )
for lineNum, el in ipairs( elems ) do
	repeat
		local oldName = el[ OLD ]
		local newName = el[ NEW ]
		local pointType = el[ TYPE ]
		-- check for common errors
		if oldName == newName then
			WriteDupError( lineNum )
			do break end
		end

		local mp, e
		if pointType and pointType ~= EOL then -- point type will be nil if processing a blank line
			mp = MapPoint.getMapPointFromNameAndType( oldName, pointType )
			if not mp then
				WriteMissingError( oldName, lineNum )
			else
				RenameMapPoint( mp, oldName, newName, lineNum )
			end
		else
			mp = MapPoint.getMapPointFromName( oldName )
			e = Model.getElementFromName( oldName )
			if not mp and e then
				RenameSection( e, oldName, newName, lineNum )
			elseif not e and mp then
				RenameMapPoint( mp, oldName, newName, lineNum )
			elseif not e and not mp then
				WriteMissingError( oldName, lineNum )
			elseif not skipAll then -- e + mp
				if not priority then
					local answer = MultipleChoice( 'A section and map point both share the name ('..oldName..'):', 
						{'Always assume renaming Sections', 'Always assume renaming Map Points', 'Rename this Section (continue to ask)', 
						'Rename this Map Point (continue to ask)', 'Skip this name', 'Skip All (not recommended)'} )
					if answer == 1 then
						elemPrrty = true
						priority = true
					elseif answer == 2 then
						priority = true
					elseif answer == 3 then
						RenameSection( e, oldName, newName, lineNum )
					elseif answer == 4 then
						RenameMapPoint( mp, oldName, newName, lineNum )
					elseif answer == 6 then
						skipAll = true
					end
				end

				if priority then
					if elemPrrty then
						RenameSection( e, oldName, newName, lineNum )
					else
						RenameMapPoint( mp, oldName, newName, lineNum )
					end
				end
			end
		end
	until true
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()

if errCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( errCount..' '..eles..' could not be renamed.\nSee the warning log for details.' )

--   Description  : This utility will find all elements that reference non-existent equipment and create 
--      new equipment for those dangling references to point to. This is useful for recovering equipment 
--      data when the eqdb has been lost. The equipment will be recreated with no data and with different 
--      names, and they will all appear in a 'Created By Utility' category in the equipment editor.  You 
--      will need to manually rename the new equipment and populate it with appropriate equipment data.
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

errCount = 0
changeCount = 0
PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
DeselectAll()

function WriteMessage( e, eqType, eqName )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Repair Invalid Equipment Refs.lua', errCode = 2,
					message = e:name()..' has invalid '..eqType..' equipment. '..
					'Now using '..eqName..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function WriteError( e, eqType )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Repair Invalid Equipment Refs.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Unable to replace invalid '..eqType..' equipment '..
					' for '..e:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteDuplicateError( e, eq, idx )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Repair Invalid Equipment Refs.lua', errCode = 3,
					message = 'Unable to replace invalid assembly '..idx..' because the GUID is being used by '..
					eq:name()..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function CreateNewName( name )
	name = name:gsub( ' [A-C]$', '' ) -- removes A, B, or C from the end of the name
	local suffix = 1
	local newName
	repeat
		newName = name..' '..tostring( suffix )
		suffix = suffix+1
	until not Equipment.checkEquipment( newName )
	return newName
end

function FixInvalid( e, eqType, eqEnum )
	local idx = e:getElementField( eqType, true )
	local eqName = e:getElementField( eqType )
	if idx and idx ~= '{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}' and not eqName then
		local newName = CreateNewName( eqType )
		local result = Equipment.createEquipment( newName, eqEnum, 'Created by Utility', idx )
		local msgType = string.lower( eqType )
		if not result then WriteError( e, msgType )
		else WriteMessage( e, msgType, result:name() ) end
	end
end

-- build a lookup of equipment GUIDs to prevent overwriting assemblies that match other equipment
local eqGuids = {}
local eqs = Equipment.getAll()
for _, eq in ipairs( eqs ) do
	eqGuids[eq:getGUID()] = eq
end

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType ~= '' and eType ~= 'Switchgear' then
		-- check Load Eq
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' or 
				eType == 'Consumer'  or eType == 'Node' then
			FixInvalid( e, 'Load Mix', 7 )
			FixInvalid( e, 'Load Zone', 9 )
		end
		-- check Conductor, Transformer, Regulator and Device Eq
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' or eType == 'Transformer' or
				eType == 'Regulator' or eType == 'Device' then
			for i=65, 67 do
				local phase = string.char( i )
				if eType == 'Overhead' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'OH Conductor '..phase, 1 )
				elseif eType == 'Underground' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'UG Conductor '..phase, 2 )
				elseif eType == 'Transformer' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'Transformer Impedance '..phase, 5 )
				elseif eType == 'Regulator' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'Regulator Equipment '..phase, 6 )
				elseif eType == 'Device' then
					FixInvalid( e, 'Device Equipment '..phase, 10 )
				end
			end
		end
		-- check Construction, fourth Conductor Eq
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then
			FixInvalid( e, 'Construction', 8 )
			local num
			if eType == 'Overhead' then num = 1 else num = 2 end
			FixInvalid( e, 'Neutral Conductor', num )
		end
		-- check Impedance Eq
		if eType == 'Source' then
			FixInvalid( e, 'Min Impedance Code', 3 )
			FixInvalid( e, 'Max Impedance Code', 3 )
		end
		-- Assembly
		local p = MapPoint.getMapPointFromNameAndType( e:name(), eType )
		if p then
			local idxs = p:getAssemblyIndices()
			for _, idx in ipairs( idxs ) do
				local eq = Equipment.getAssemblyFromIndex( idx )
				if not eq and eqGuids[idx] then
					WriteDuplicateError( e, eqGuids[idx], idx )
				elseif not eq then
					local newName = CreateNewName( 'Assembly' )
					local result = Equipment.createEquipment( newName, 13, 'Created by Utility', idx )
					if not result then WriteError( e, 'assembly' )
					else WriteMessage( e, 'assembly', newName ) end
				end
			end
		end
	end
    StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()

local inst = 'instances'
if errCount == 1 then inst = 'instance' end
if errCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( errCount..' '..inst..' of invalid equipment could not be repaired.'..
		'\nSee the warning log for details.' )

	inst = 'instance'

	Alert( changeCount..' '..inst..' of invalid equipment '..were..' repaired.'..

elseif changeCount == 0 and errCount == 0 then
	Alert( 'No instances of invalid equipment were found.' )
end

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Rephase Elements in File.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.1
--   Input        : None
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log
--   Description  : This utility will attempt to open a file called 'rephase.txt' in the .wm directory.  This 
--     file should contain one or more comma delimited lines that indicate which elements to rephase and what the
--     new phase should be.  The first field on each line is the name of the element to be rephased; the second 
--     field can either be a string or an integer representing the new phase.  If a string is used it should be 
--     A, B, C, AB, AC, BC, or ABC. If an integer is used it should be a number (1-7) where A=1 B=2 C=3 AB=4 AC=5
--     BC=6 ABC=7
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

errCount = 0
changeCount = 0
PushDrawingEnabled( false )

function WriteMissingError( e, num )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rephase Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'The element '..e..' on line '..num..' does not exist.'} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteIllegalError( num )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rephase Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Input file contains an illegal phase on line '..num..'.'} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteParentlessError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rephase Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Error in linkage: element '..e:name()..'has no parent.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteUnavailableError( e, num )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rephase Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Could not rephase '..e:name()..' on line '..num..': The requested phase was not available '..
					'in the first multiphase element upline.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteError( e, old, new )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rephase Elements in File.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = 'Element '..e:name()..' could not be rephased from '..old..' to '..new..'.'
					, GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( e, old, new )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Rephase Elements in File.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = 'Element '..e:name()..' was rephased from '..old..' to '..new..'.'
					, GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function FindPhase( phase )
	local phaseNum = 0
	if string.find( phase, 'A' ) then phaseNum = phaseNum+1 end
	if string.find( phase, 'B' ) then phaseNum = phaseNum+2 end
	if string.find( phase, 'C' ) then phaseNum = phaseNum+4 end
	return phaseNum
end

function Rephase( e, newPhase, oldPhase )
	local phaseNum = FindPhase( newPhase )
	local result = e:rephase( phaseNum )
	if not result then WriteError( e, oldPhase, newPhase )
	else WriteMessage( e, oldPhase, newPhase ) end
end

local fileName = GetModelPath()..'rephase.txt'
local file = io.open( fileName )
if not file then
	fileName = PromptOpenFile( 'Where is your rephase file located?', 'C:\\', 'Text Files (*.txt)|*.txt|CSV Files (*.csv)|*.csv|All Files|*.*' )
	if not fileName or fileName == '' then do return end end
	file = assert( io.open( fileName ), 'File not found.' )
end
io.input( fileName )

local elems = {}
for line in file:lines() do
	local t = {}
	string.gsub( line..",","([^,]*),", function ( x ) table.insert( t, x ) end )
	table.insert( elems, t )
end
file:close()

local phases = {'A','B','C','AB','AC','BC','ABC'}
CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #elems )
for _, el in ipairs( elems ) do
    local element = el[ 1 ]
    local newPhase = el[ 2 ]
    local e = Model.getElementFromName( element )

	local invalid = false
	-- check for common errors
	if not e then 
		WriteMissingError( element, _ )
		invalid = true
	end

	local phO, phN, ph
	if not invalid then
		ph = e:getElementField( 'Phase Order' )
		if type( tonumber(newPhase) ) == 'number' then
			newPhase = phases[ tonumber(newPhase) ]
		end
		local res = false
		for i=1, 7 do
			res = ( newPhase == phases[ i ] )
			if res then break end
		end
		if not res then
			WriteIllegalError( _ )
			invalid = true
		end
		local phO = #ph
		local phN = #newPhase
	end

	-- check parents for valid phasing
	if not invalid then
		local p = e:parent()
		local prev = e
		local foundParent = false
		while p do
			local phasing = p:getElementField( 'Phasing' )
			if string.find( phasing, newPhase ) then
				foundParent = true
				break
			elseif #phasing > 1 then
				WriteUnavailableError( e, _ )
				invalid = true
				break
			end
			prev = p
			p = p:parent()
		end
		if not invalid and not foundParent then WriteParentlessError( prev, _ ) end
	end

	-- handle center taps
	if not invalid then
		local cTap = e:getElementField( 'Is Center Tap' )
		if cTap and cTap ~= 'None' then
			if newPhase == 'A' then newPhase = 'AB'
			elseif newPhase == 'B' then newPhase = 'BC'
			elseif newPhase == 'C' then newPhase = 'AC' end
		end
	end

	if not invalid and ph ~= newPhase then
		Rephase( e, newPhase, ph )
	end
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()

if errCount == 1 then eles = 'element' end
if errCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( errCount..' '..eles..' could not be rephased.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
end
eles = 'elements have'

	Alert( changeCount..' '..eles..' been rephased.\n See the warning log for details.' )
elseif changeCount == 0 and errCount == 0 then
	Alert( 'No elements were rephased.' )
end

end

function WriteMessage( e, x, y )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Ring Children.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = 'Moved '..e:name()..' to '..x..', '..y..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

function allowableType( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	for i=1, #ALLOWED_TYPE do
		if ALLOWED_TYPE[i] == eType and not e:getElementField( 'In Switchgear' ) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function Ring( e )
	local children = e:children()
	if #children == 0 then return end
	local dtheta = 2 * 3.14 / #children
	local theta = 0
	local x, y = e:location()
	for i=1, #children do
		local c = children[ i ]
		if allowableType( c ) then
			local oldX, oldY = c:location()
			local setX, setY = x + MOVE_DIST * math.cos( theta ), y + MOVE_DIST * math.sin( theta )
			local newX, newY = c:forceSetAltLocation( setX, setY )
			
			if newX == setX and newY == setY then WriteMessage( c, newX, newY )
			elseif newX == oldX and newY == oldY then WriteError( c, oldX, oldY ) end	
		end
		theta = theta + dtheta
	end
end

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
local selectStr = 'In the current selection set of '..#t..' section(s),'
if #t == 0 then
	SelectAll()
	t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
	selectStr = 'In the entire model of '..#t..' section(s),'
	DeselectAll()
end

CreateProgressBar( 'Running utility.  Please wait...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	Ring( e )
    StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
local ele = 'elements'
if errCount == 1 then ele = 'element' end
if errCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( selectStr..'\n'..errCount..' '..ele..' could not be moved.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
end
ele = 'elements were'
if changeCount == 1 then ele = 'element was' end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( selectStr..'\n'..changeCount..' '..ele..' moved.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
elseif changeCount == 0 and errCount == 0 then
	Alert( selectStr..'\n'..'No elements needed to be moved.' )
end

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Snap Lines and Points.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2
--   Input        : Current selection set.  If none selected, selects all.
--   Return       : Prints number modified and results to the Warning Log  
--   Description  : Finds all line or segments near a map point and snaps the point or the line (depending on settings).
--                  Then finds all map points that are near a line and snaps.  New segments are inserted if necessary.
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		GLOBAL VARIABLES
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS
local POINTS_TO_LINES = true         -- snap points to lines (true) or lines to points (false)
local ALLOWED_TYPE =                 -- a table of map point types to snap to
	{                                -- commented out types (those with -- in front) will not be used
		'Pole',
--		'Tower',
--		'Pad',
--		'Pedestal',
--		'Junction Box',
--		'Enclosure',
--		'Vault',
--		'PullBox',
--		'Foreign Structure',
--		'Marker',
--		'Light',
--		'Surface Structure',
--		'Storage Location',
--		'Non-Utility Facility'
	}

-- It is recommended to run both, specifically lines first and points second (as the script does by default).
-- This is to ensure that points snap to end points first (checking lines), before creating segments (checking points).

local ONLY_SNAP_EXISTING = false     -- only snap to existing segments (true) or create new ones if necessary (false)
local ONLY_CHECK_ENDPOINTS = false   -- only snap to end points (true) or snap to any segment (false)
local ONLY_CHECK_FROM_LINES = false  -- iterate over lines only (true) or iterate both (false)
local ONLY_CHECK_FROM_POINTS = false -- iterate over map points only (true) or iterate both (false)
-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS

local errCount = 0
local changeCount = 0

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		ERROR REPORTING FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function WriteError( e )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Snap Lines and Points.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = e:name()..' could not be moved.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

-- can only occur during move points
function WriteSplitFail( e, x, y )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Snap Lines and Points.lua', errCode = 3, 
					message = e:name()..' could not be split at '..x..', '..y..'.', GUID = e:getGUID()} )
	errCount = errCount+1
end

function WriteMessage( e1, e2, x, y )
	WriteToErrorLog( {line = 0, file = 'Snap Lines and Points.lua', errCode = 2, 
					message = e1:name()..' was moved to '..e2:name()..' at '..x..', '..y..'.', GUID = e1:getGUID()} )
	changeCount = changeCount+1
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		LIBRARY FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function allowableType( p )
	local pType = p:pointType()
	for i=1, #ALLOWED_TYPE do
		if ALLOWED_TYPE[i] == pType then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function isLine( e )
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then return true end
	return false
end

function distance( x1, y1, x2, y2 )
	return math.sqrt( (x2-x1)*(x2-x1) + (y2-y1)*(y2-y1) )
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function pointAlreadyOnLine( p, e )
	local xSegs, ySegs = e:getSegmentCoordinates()
	local pointX, pointY = p:location()
	for i=1, #xSegs do
		local lineX, lineY = xSegs[i], ySegs[i]
		if lineX == pointX and lineY == pointY then return true end
	end
	return false
end

function findClosestPoint( e, x, y )
	local points = MapPoint.getInRadius( x, y, THRESHOLD )
	local closePoint = nil
	local closeDistance = -1
	local closeX, closeY
	local attachedPoints = MapPoint.getInRadius( x, y, 0 )
	-- check if point already attached at this location
	for _, attachedPoint in ipairs( attachedPoints ) do
		local x1, y1 = attachedPoint:location()
		if x1 == x and y1 == y then return end
	end
	for _, point in ipairs( points ) do
		if allowableType( point ) and not pointAlreadyOnLine( point, e ) then
			local x1, y1 = point:location()
			local tempDist = distance( x, y, x1, y1 )
			if closeDistance == -1 or closeDistance > tempDist then
				closePoint = point
				closeDistance = tempDist
				closeX, closeY = x1, y1
			end
		end
	end
	return closePoint, closeX, closeY
end

function findClosestLine( p )
	local x, y = p:location()
	local elements = Model.getInRadius( x, y, THRESHOLD )
	local closeLine = nil
	local closeDistance = -1
	local closeX, closeY
	for _, e in ipairs( elements ) do
		if isLine( e ) and not e:getElementField( 'In Switchgear' ) then
			local x1, y1
			if ONLY_CHECK_ENDPOINTS then
				x1, y1 = e:location()
			else
				x1, y1 = e:closestPointOnLine( x, y )
			end
			local tempDist = distance( x, y, x1, y1 )
			if closeDistance == -1 or closeDistance > tempDist then
				closeLine = e
				closeDistance = tempDist
				closeX, closeY = x1, y1
			end
		end
	end
	return closeLine, closeX, closeY
end

-- find closest point on line (out of both end points and any existing segments)
function findClosestLinePoint( line, p )
	local xCoords, yCoords = line:getSegmentCoordinates()
	local closePoint = nil
	local closeDistance = -1
	local closeX, closeY
	local pointX, pointY = p:location()
	for i=1, #xCoords do
		repeat
			if ONLY_CHECK_ENDPOINTS and i ~= 1 and i ~= #xCoords then do break end end
			local x, y = xCoords[i], yCoords[i]
			local tempDist = distance( pointX, pointY, x, y )
			if closeDistance ~= -1 and closeDistance <= tempDist then do break end end
			closePoint = i
			closeDistance = tempDist
			closeX, closeY = xCoords[i], yCoords[i]
		until true
	end
	return closePoint, closeX, closeY
end

function locationContainsPoint( x, y )
	if not x or not y then return false end
	local points = MapPoint.getInRadius( x, y, 0 )
	for _, point in ipairs( points ) do
		local x1, y1 = point:location()
		if x1 == x and y1 == y then return true end
	end
	return false
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
local elements = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
local points = MapPoint.getCurrentSelectionSet()
local selectStr = 'In the current selection set of '..#elements + #points..' feature(s),'
if #elements == 0 and #points == 0 then -- if only one is empty, assume user only wanted to run against that type
	SelectAll()
	elements = Model.getCurrentSelectionSetSections()
	points = MapPoint.getCurrentSelectionSet()
	selectStr = 'In the entire model of '..#elements + #points..' feature(s),'
	DeselectAll()
end
if ONLY_CHECK_FROM_LINES then points = {} end
if ONLY_CHECK_FROM_POINTS then elements = {} end

THRESHOLD = PromptString( 'How far are you willing to move an element to be snapped? (in WindMil units)', 0.5 )
THRESHOLD = tonumber( THRESHOLD )
if not THRESHOLD then
	elements = {}
	points = {}
end

CreateProgressBar( 'Searching lines.  Please wait...', #elements )
for _, e in ipairs( elements ) do
	repeat
		if not isLine( e ) or e:getElementField( 'In Switchgear' ) then do break end end
		local xSegs, ySegs = e:getSegmentCoordinates()
		for i=2, #xSegs do -- skip alt location (prevents snapping other elements incorrectly)
			-- CHECKING SEGS LIKE THIS WON'T WORK IF THRESHOLD GETS TOO LARGE
            repeat
                if ONLY_CHECK_ENDPOINTS and i ~= #xSegs then do break end end
                local x, y = xSegs[i], ySegs[i]
                local point, pointX, pointY = findClosestPoint( e, x, y )
                if not point or ( x == pointX and y == pointY ) then do break end end
                if not POINTS_TO_LINES then -- move line
                    local tempX, tempY = e:setSegmentLocation( i, pointX, pointY )
                    if tempX ~= pointX or tempY ~= pointY then WriteError( e )
                    else WriteMessage( e, point, pointX, pointY ) end
                else                        -- move point
                    local tempX, tempY = point:setLocation( x, y )
                    if tempX ~= x or tempY ~= y then WriteError( point )
                    else WriteMessage( point, e, x, y ) end
                end
            until true
		end
	until true
    StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()

CreateProgressBar( 'Searching map points.  Please wait...', #points )
for _, p in ipairs( points ) do
	repeat
		if not allowableType( p ) then do break end end
		local x, y = p:location()
		local line, lineX, lineY = findClosestLine( p )
		if not line or ( x == lineX and y == lineY ) then do break end end
		local segIdx, segX, segY = findClosestLinePoint( line, p )
		if locationContainsPoint( segX, segY ) then segIdx = nil end
		-- set new location
		if segIdx and distance( x, y, segX, segY ) < THRESHOLD then -- closest point is an existing
			if not POINTS_TO_LINES then -- move line
				local tempX, tempY = line:setSegmentLocation( segIdx, x, y )
				if tempX ~= x or tempY ~= y then WriteError( line )
				else WriteMessage( line, p, x, y ) end
			else                        -- move point
				local tempX, tempY = p:setLocation( segX, segY )
				if tempX ~= segX or tempY ~= segY then WriteError( p )
				else WriteMessage( p, line, segX, segY ) end
			end
		elseif not ONLY_SNAP_EXISTING and distance( x, y, lineX, lineY ) < THRESHOLD then      -- closest point is a new segment
			line:splitSegment( lineX, lineY )
			if not POINTS_TO_LINES then -- move line
				local xCoords, yCoords = line:getSegmentCoordinates()
				local segIndex = nil
				for i=2, #xCoords-1 do -- new segment can't be at alt location or location
					local currX, currY = xCoords[i], yCoords[i]
					-- to account for slight variations from the split
					if tostring( currX ) == tostring( lineX ) and tostring( currY ) == tostring( lineY ) then
						segIndex = i
						break
					end
				end
				if not segIndex then
					WriteSplitFail( line, lineX, lineY )
				else
					local tempX, tempY = line:setSegmentLocation( segIndex, x, y )
					if tempX ~= x or tempY ~= y then WriteError( line )
					else WriteMessage( line, p, x, y ) end
				end
			else                        -- move point
				local tempX, tempY = p:setLocation( lineX, lineY )
				if tempX ~= lineX or tempY ~= lineY then WriteError( p )
				else WriteMessage( p, line, lineX, lineY ) end
			end
		end
	until true
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()

-- GENERAL OUTPUT INFORMATION
local elems = 'elements'
if errCount == 1 then elems = 'element' end
if errCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( selectStr..'\n'..errCount..' '..elems..' could not be moved.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
end
elems = 'elements were'
if changeCount == 1 then elems = 'element was' end
if changeCount ~= 0 then
	Alert( selectStr..'\n'..changeCount..' '..elems..' successfully moved.\nSee the warning log for details.' )
elseif changeCount == 0 and errCount == 0 then
	Alert( selectStr..'\n'..'No elements needed to be moved.' )
end

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION

--   Description  : This script contains an output class with functions for writing common Library output

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		LIBRARY FUNCTIONS (not shared)
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local library = {}

function library.safeWriteField( field )
	if not field then return '' end
	return tostring( field )
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		OUTPUT CLASS AND FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local outputClass = {}

function outputClass.WriteReport( passedInTable, fields )
	if not WRITE_TO_FILE then return end
	if not passedInTable or not fields then
		print( 'Cannot write report because table is invalid.\n' )
		return
	end
	-- ensure report won't be empty before starting
	local count = 0
	for _, e in pairs( passedInTable ) do
		count = count+1
		break
	end
	if count == 0 then return end
	-- create file
	local reportName = REPORT_PATH..'\\'..CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME..'.csv'
	local reportFile = assert( io.open( reportName, 'w+' ), reportName..' file not accessible.' )
	-- generate header
	reportFile:write( 'Element Name,Phasing' )
	for _, field in ipairs( fields ) do
		reportFile:write( ','..field )
	end
	reportFile:write( '\n' )
	-- fill out report
	for _, e in pairs( passedInTable ) do
		reportFile:write( e:name()..','..e:getElementField( 'Phasing' ) )
		for _, field in ipairs( fields ) do
			reportFile:write( ','..library.safeWriteField( e:getElementField( field ) ) )
		end
		reportFile:write( '\n' )
	end
	reportFile:flush()
	reportFile:close()
end

function outputClass.CreateSelectionSet( passedInTable )
	if not CREATE_SELECTION_SET then return end
	if not passedInTable then
		print( 'Cannot create selection set because table is invalid.\n' )
		return
	end
	DeselectAll()
	for _, e in pairs( passedInTable ) do
		e:setSelected( true )
	end
	if SaveCurrentSelectionSet( CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME, true --[[overwrite]] ) == -1 then
		Alert( 'Failed to save the '..CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME..' selection set. Make sure you don\'t have too many sets already stored.' )
	end
	DeselectAll()
end

function outputClass.PrintCount( passedInTable, message )
	if not passedInTable then
		print( 'Cannot print count because table is invalid.\n' )
		return
	end
	local count = 0
	for _, __ in pairs( passedInTable ) do
		count = count+1
	end
	print( count..' ', message, '.\n' ) -- treat message as a parameter, in case of nil
end

return outputClass

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		LIBRARY FUNCTIONS (not shared)
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local library = {}

-- convert stored mapping number into element type
function library.getTypeString( num, num2 )
	if num == 1 then return 'Overhead' end
	if num == 3 then return 'Underground' end
	if num == 4 then return 'Regulator' end
	if num == 5 then return 'Transformer' end
	if num == 6 then return 'Switch' end
	if num == 9 then return 'Source' end
	if num == 20 then return 'Generator' end
	if num == 21 then return 'Motor' end
	if num == 22 then return 'Device' end
	if num == 23 then return 'Node' end
	if num == 24 then return 'Capacitor' end
	if num == 28 then return 'Consumer' end
	if num == 29 then
		if num2 == 0 then return 'Pole' end
		if num2 == 1 then return 'Tower' end
		if num2 == 2 then return 'Pad' end
		if num2 == 3 then return 'Pedestal' end
		if num2 == 4 then return 'Junction Box' end
		if num2 == 5 then return 'Enclosure' end
		if num2 == 6 then return 'Vault' end
		if num2 == 7 then return 'PullBox' end
		if num2 == 8 then return 'Foreign Structure' end
		if num2 == 9 then return 'Marker' end
		if num2 == 10 then return 'Light' end
		if num2 == 11 then return 'Surface Structure' end
		if num2 == 12 then return 'Storage Location' end
		if num2 == 13 then return 'Non-Utility Facility' end
	end
	if num == 30 then return '' end -- Switchgear
	-- returns nil by default
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		READ EXTERNALS CLASS AND FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local readExternalsClass = {}

function readExternalsClass.GetTableUses( extTable )
	local allTableData = GetPreference( 'ExternalTables' )
	-- parse the JSON preference to find which tables are associated to with which elements
	local tableAlias = extTable:alias()
	local tableData = allTableData:match( '"'..tableAlias..'":.-"mappings":.-}' )
	if not tableData then
		Alert( 'Script failed to find table information for '..tableAlias..', so the script cannot find records for this table.' )
		return
	end
	local mapping = tableData:match( '"mappings":%[.-%],"' )
	if not mapping then
		Alert( 'Mapping information missing for '..tableAlias..', so the script cannot find records for this table.' )
		return
	end
	local elementTypes = {}
	while mapping and mapping:find( '%[%d' ) do
		local mapNum1 = tonumber( mapping:sub( mapping:find( '%[%d' )+1, mapping:find( ',' )-1 ) )
		local mapNum2 = tonumber( mapping:sub( mapping:find( ',' )+1, mapping:find( '%]' )-1 ) )
		local eType = library.getTypeString( mapNum1, mapNum2 )
		if not eType then
			Alert( 'Element type could not be found for '..tableAlias..', so the script cannot find records for this table.' )
			return
		end
		mapping = mapping:sub( mapping:find( '%],' )+2, #mapping )
		table.insert( elementTypes, eType )
	end
	return elementTypes
end

return readExternalsClass

		LIBRARY FUNCTIONS (private)
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local library = {}

-- defaults used for the multi-choice
library.done = 'DONE'
library.next = 'NEXT >'
library.back = '< BACK'
library.all = 'ALL'
library.choiceMax = 10 -- 10 is current max per page

function library.removeOrAddToTable( currTable, value )
	local removed = false
	for i, val in ipairs( currTable ) do
		if val == value then
			table.remove( currTable, i )
			removed = true
			break
		end
	end
	-- if nothing is left, select 'ALL'
	if removed and #currTable == 0 then
		return {library.all}
	end
	-- if adding 'ALL', remove other values
	if not removed and value == library.all then
		return {value}
	end
	-- if 'ALL' exists, remove if adding a new value
	if not removed and library.all == currTable[1] then
		table.remove( currTable, 1 )
	end
	if not removed then
		table.insert( currTable, value )
	end
	return currTable
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		SELECT ELEMENT TYPE CLASS AND FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local selectElementTypeClass = {}

function selectElementTypeClass.Initialize( settings )
	if not settings.choices or #settings.choices == 0 or not settings.elementType or settings.elementType == '' or not settings.filterField or settings.filterField == '' then
		Alert( 'Cannot create an element selector because invalid data was provided.' )
	end
	-- build 'choices' for our multi-choice selector
	table.insert( settings.choices, 1, library.all )
	table.insert( settings.choices, library.done )
	local currMax = library.choiceMax
	if #settings.choices <= currMax then return settings.choices end
	local i = 1
	while ( #settings.choices - currMax*i > 0 ) do
		table.insert( settings.choices, currMax*i-1, library.next )
		table.insert( settings.choices, currMax*i, library.done )
		table.insert( settings.choices, currMax*i+1, library.back )
		i = i+1
	end
	return settings.choices
end

function selectElementTypeClass.IsSelectedType( element, settings )
	-- only filter for current element type
	if element:elementType() ~= settings.elementType then
		return false
	end
	local selectedTypes -- should be nil unless actually set, avoid passing full selection when not necessary
	if #settings.selectedTypes == 0 then
		local currentSelections = {library.all}
		local choiceStart = 1
		local choiceEnd = library.choiceMax
		if #settings.choices < choiceEnd then choiceEnd = #settings.choices end
		local currentChoices = {unpack( settings.choices, choiceStart, choiceEnd )}
		local result = 0
		repeat
			result = MultipleChoice( 'Filter by: ('..table.concat( currentSelections, ', ' )..')', currentChoices )
			if result == -1 then
				Alert( 'No type selected.  No matches will be made.' )
				table.insert( selectedTypes, '---' )
				return false, selectedTypes
			end
			local resultChoice = settings.choices[result + choiceStart-1]
			if resultChoice == library.next then
				choiceStart = choiceStart + library.choiceMax
				choiceEnd = choiceEnd + library.choiceMax
				if #settings.choices < choiceEnd then choiceEnd = #settings.choices end
				currentChoices = {unpack( settings.choices, choiceStart, choiceEnd )}
			elseif resultChoice == library.back then
				local choicesDiff = choiceEnd - choiceStart + 1
				choiceStart = choiceStart - library.choiceMax
				choiceEnd = choiceEnd - choicesDiff
				currentChoices = {unpack( settings.choices, choiceStart, choiceEnd )}
			elseif resultChoice ~= library.done then
				currentSelections = library.removeOrAddToTable( currentSelections, resultChoice )
			end
		until resultChoice == library.done
		selectedTypes = currentSelections
		settings.selectedTypes = selectedTypes
	end
	-- always a valid type if selection is 'All'
	if settings.selectedTypes[1] == library.all then
		return true, selectedTypes
	end
	local actualType = element:getElementField( settings.filterField )
	for _, currType in ipairs( settings.selectedTypes ) do
		if currType == actualType then
			return true, selectedTypes
		end
	end
	return false, selectedTypes
end

return selectElementTypeClass

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Find Duplicate Elements.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2.0
--   Input        : None
--   Return       : Writes detailed files containing duplicate information
--   Description  : This script finds duplicate elements of various types:
--                  - Exact Duplicate file contains exact duplicates (not allowed by our system) and how many exist
--                  - Renamed Duplicate file contains all .# elements (can break compatibility with other products)
--                  - Allowed Duplicate file contains duplicate map points across types (not always done purposely)
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		GLOBAL VARIABLES
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dofile( '..\\Model Integrity\\Common\\Model Integrity Library Globals.lua' ) -- common globals used for manual file run

-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS
local ENFORCE_DOT_LENGTH = 3             -- only check .# less than or equal to this length 
                                         -- (comment out or set to nil/false to remove limit)
local path = REPORT_PATH..'\\'..CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME
local EXACT_PATH = path..' Exact.csv'    -- file name for exact duplicate
local RENAME_PATH = path..' Renamed.csv' -- file name for renamed duplicate
local ALLOW_PATH = path..' Allowed.csv'  -- file name for allowed duplicate
-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS

local POINT_TYPES =
	{
		'Pole',
		'Tower',
		'Pad',
		'Pedestal',
		'Junction Box',
		'Enclosure',
		'Vault',
		'PullBox',
		'Foreign Structure',
		'Marker',
		'Light',
		'Surface Structure',
		'Storage Location',
		'Non-Utility Facility'
	}

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function FindExactDuplicates( fileTable, searchTable )
	for name, subTable in pairs( searchTable ) do
		if type( subTable ) == 'table' and #subTable > 1 then
			table.insert( fileTable, name..','..subTable[1]:elementType()..','..tostring( #subTable )..'\n' )
		end
	end
	return fileTable
end

function WriteTableToFile( currTable, file )
	for _, line in ipairs( currTable ) do
		file:write( line )
	end
	file:flush()
	file:close()
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Model.getCurrentSelectionSet()
DeselectAll()

local SECTIONS = {}
local MAP_POINTS = {}
local RENAME_FILE_CONTENTS = {}
local ALLOW_FILE_CONTENTS = {}
CreateProgressBar( 'Checking names on all sections...', #t )
for _, e in ipairs( t ) do
	local eType = e:elementType()
	if eType == '' then eType = 'Switchgear' end
	local isSection = (e:getElementField( 'Map Point Name' ) == nil)

	local eName = e:name()
	-- look for renamed .# duplicates
	local start, finish = eName:find( '%.%d+$' ) -- .# at end of string
	if start and ( not ENFORCE_DOT_LENGTH or finish - start <= ENFORCE_DOT_LENGTH ) then
		table.insert( RENAME_FILE_CONTENTS, eName..','..eType..'\n' )
	end
	-- look for allowed duplicates
	if isSection then
		local subTable = MAP_POINTS[eName]
		if subTable then
			table.insert( ALLOW_FILE_CONTENTS, eName..','..eType..','..subTable[1]:elementType()..'\n' )
		end
	else
		local subTable = SECTIONS[eName]
		if subTable then
			table.insert( ALLOW_FILE_CONTENTS, eName..','..eType..','..subTable[1]:elementType()..'\n' )
		else
			for _, pType in ipairs( POINT_TYPES ) do
				repeat
					if pType == eType then do break end end
					local subTable = MAP_POINTS[eName..' '..pType]
					if not subTable then do break end end
					table.insert( ALLOW_FILE_CONTENTS, eName..','..eType..','..subTable[1]:elementType()..'\n' )
				until true
			end
		end
	end
	-- add names to tables for tracking
	if isSection then
		local subTable = SECTIONS[eName]
		if not subTable then subTable = {} end
		table.insert( subTable, e )
		SECTIONS[eName] = subTable
	else
		local subTable = MAP_POINTS[eName..' '..eType]
		if not subTable then subTable = {} end
		table.insert( subTable, e )
		MAP_POINTS[eName..' '..eType] = subTable
		-- also track just name for allowed file (but only store one to avoid conflict with exact file)
		local singleEntry = MAP_POINTS[eName]
		if not singleEntry then
			MAP_POINTS[eName] = {e}
		end
	end
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()
-- find the exact duplicates before writing output
local EXACT_FILE_CONTENTS = FindExactDuplicates( {}, SECTIONS )
EXACT_FILE_CONTENTS = FindExactDuplicates( EXACT_FILE_CONTENTS, MAP_POINTS )

-- GENERAL OUTPUT INFORMATION
if not WRITE_TO_FILE then
	print( CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME..' results always attempt to write to file.\n' )
end

if #EXACT_FILE_CONTENTS > 0 then
	local file = assert( io.open( EXACT_PATH, 'w+' ), 'Exact Duplicates file not found or not accessible for writing.' )
	file:write( 'Element Name,Type,Duplicate Count\n' )
	WriteTableToFile( EXACT_FILE_CONTENTS, file )
end

if #RENAME_FILE_CONTENTS > 0 then
	local file = assert( io.open( RENAME_PATH, 'w+' ), 'Renamed Duplicates file not found or not accessible for writing.' )
	file:write( 'Element Name,Type\n' )
	WriteTableToFile( RENAME_FILE_CONTENTS, file )
end

if #ALLOW_FILE_CONTENTS > 0 then
	local file = assert( io.open( ALLOW_PATH, 'w+' ), 'Allowed Duplicates file not found or not accessible for writing.' )
	file:write( 'Element Name,Type,Duplicate Type\n' )
	WriteTableToFile( ALLOW_FILE_CONTENTS, file )
end

if CREATE_SELECTION_SET then
	print( CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME..' does not support creating selection sets at this time.\n' )
end

local output = require( 'Scripts.Model Integrity.Common.Output' )
output.PrintCount( EXACT_FILE_CONTENTS, 'exact duplicate element(s) found' --[[message]] )
output.PrintCount( RENAME_FILE_CONTENTS, 'renamed duplicate element(s) found' --[[message]] )
output.PrintCount( ALLOW_FILE_CONTENTS, 'allowed duplicate element(s) found' --[[message]] )

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Find Duplicate Equipment.lua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2.0
--   Input        : None
--   Return       : Can write reports, generate selection sets, and print results
--   Description  : This utility finds potentially duplicate equipment in the EQDB.
--                  - Exact Duplicate file contains exact duplicates (not allowed by our system)
--                  - Possible Duplicate file contains duplicates after removing alphanumeric characters
--                  - Partial Duplicate file contains duplicates matching a portion of another name
--   Customer     : ---
-- END DESCRIPTION

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		GLOBAL VARIABLES
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dofile( '..\\Model Integrity\\Common\\Model Integrity Library Globals.lua' ) -- common globals used for manual file run

-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS
local REPORT_PARTIAL = false                -- partial matches contain a large number of false positives
local PARTIAL_NAME_CUTOFF = 4               -- names shorter than this shouldn't be considered for partial matches
local path = REPORT_PATH..'\\'..CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME
local EXACT_PATH = path..' Exact.csv'       -- file name for exact duplicate
local POSSIBLE_PATH = path..' Possible.csv' -- file name for possible duplicate
local PARTIAL_PATH = path..' Partial.csv'   -- file name for partial duplicate
-- EDIT THESE TO CUSTOMIZE HOW YOUR SCRIPT WORKS

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function UpdateRecordForTable( currTable, key, entry, duplicateEntry )
	local existingDupes = currTable[key]
	if not existingDupes then existingDupes = {duplicateEntry} end
	table.insert( existingDupes, entry )
	return existingDupes
end

function WriteTableToFile( currTable, file, writeDupeNames )
	for eqName, eqDupes in pairs( currTable ) do
		local eq = eqDupes[1]
		file:write( eq:name()..','..eq:equipmentType()..','..#eqDupes )
		for i=2, #eqDupes do
			local eqDupe = eqDupes[i]
			file:write( ',' )
			if writeDupeNames then
				file:write( eqDupe:name()..',' )
			end
			file:write( eqDupe:equipmentType() )
		end
		file:write( '\n' )
	end
	file:flush()
	file:close()
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

PushDrawingEnabled( false )
SelectAll()
local t = Equipment.getAll()
DeselectAll()

local EXACT_TABLE = {}
local POTENTIAL_TABLE = {}
local PARTIAL_TABLE = {}
local eqByShortName = {}
local eqByName = {}
CreateProgressBar( 'Checking names of equipment...', #t )
for _, eq in ipairs( t ) do
	repeat
		-- check for exact duplicates
		local eqName = eq:name()
		local duplicate = eqByName[eqName]
		if duplicate then
			EXACT_TABLE[eqName] = UpdateRecordForTable( EXACT_TABLE, eqName, eq, duplicate )
			do break end
		else
			eqByName[eqName] = eq
		end
		-- check for potential duplicates
		local cleanedName = eqName:gsub( '[^%w]', '' ) -- remove all non-alphanumeric characters
		if not cleanedName or cleanedName == '' then
			do break end
		end
		local potentialDuplicate = eqByShortName[cleanedName]
		if potentialDuplicate then
			POTENTIAL_TABLE[cleanedName] = UpdateRecordForTable( POTENTIAL_TABLE, cleanedName, eq, potentialDuplicate )
			do break end
		else
			eqByShortName[cleanedName] = eq
		end
		-- check for partial duplicates
		if not REPORT_PARTIAL or #cleanedName < PARTIAL_NAME_CUTOFF then do break end end
		if PARTIAL_TABLE[cleanedName] then do break end end -- avoid inserting entries again; partials check against all
		for __, otherEq in ipairs( t ) do
			repeat
				if eq:getGUID() == otherEq:getGUID() then do break end end
				local otherCleanedName = otherEq:name():gsub( '[^%w]', '' ) -- remove all non-alphanumeric characters
				if not otherCleanedName or otherCleanedName == '' then do break end end
				if not otherCleanedName:find( cleanedName ) then do break end end
				PARTIAL_TABLE[cleanedName] = UpdateRecordForTable( PARTIAL_TABLE, cleanedName, otherEq, eq )
			until true
		end
	until true
	StepProgressBar( 1 )
end
HideProgressBar()
PopDrawingEnabled()

-- GENERAL OUTPUT INFORMATION
local output = require( 'Scripts.Model Integrity.Common.Output' )
if not WRITE_TO_FILE then
	print( CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME..' results always attempt to write to file.\n' )
end

if next( EXACT_TABLE ) then
	local file = assert( io.open( EXACT_PATH, 'w+' ), 'Exact Duplicates file not found or not accessible for writing.' )
	file:write( 'Equipment Name,Equipment Type,Duplicate Count,Duplicate Types\n' )
	WriteTableToFile( EXACT_TABLE, file )
end

if next( POTENTIAL_TABLE ) then
	local file = assert( io.open( POSSIBLE_PATH, 'w+' ), 'Possible Duplicates file not found or not accessible for writing.' )
	file:write( 'Equipment Name,Equipment Type,Permutation Count,Permutation Names,Permutation Types\n' )
	WriteTableToFile( POTENTIAL_TABLE, file, true --[[writeDuplicateNames]] )
end

if REPORT_PARTIAL and next( PARTIAL_TABLE ) then
	local file = assert( io.open( PARTIAL_PATH, 'w+' ), 'Partial Duplicates file not found or not accessible for writing.' )
	file:write( 'Equipment Name,Equipment Type,Permutation Count,Permutation Names,Permutation Types\n' )
	WriteTableToFile( PARTIAL_TABLE, file, true --[[writeDuplicateNames]] )
end

if CREATE_SELECTION_SET then
	print( CURRENT_SCRIPT_NAME..' does not support creating selection sets at this time.\n' )
end

local output = require( 'Scripts.Model Integrity.Common.Output' )
output.PrintCount( EXACT_TABLE, 'exact duplicate equipment found' --[[message]] )
output.PrintCount( POTENTIAL_TABLE, 'potential duplicate equipment found' --[[message]] )
if REPORT_PARTIAL then
	output.PrintCount( PARTIAL_TABLE, 'partial duplicate equipment found' --[[message]] )
end

dofile( '..\\Model Integrity\\Common\\Model Integrity Library Globals.lua' ) -- common globals used for manual file run

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		LIBRARY FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function getEquipmentFieldName( eType )
	if eType == 'Capacitor' then return 'Capacitor Kvar ' end
	if eType == 'Device' then return 'Device Equipment ' end
	if eType == 'Overhead' then return 'OH Conductor ' end
	if eType == 'Regulator' then return 'Regulator Equipment ' end
	if eType == 'Transformer' then return 'Transformer Impedance ' end
	if eType == 'Underground' then return 'UG Conductor ' end
	return ''

-- TODO: consider sharing out internal library function from Output.lua
function safeWriteField( field )
	if not field then return '' end
	return tostring( field )
end

--[[----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		MAIN SCRIPT FUNCTIONS
--]]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function IsValidPhase( e, phase )
	if e:elementType() ~= 'Transformer' then return true end

-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Angle with Parent.elua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2
--   Input        : None

--   Description  : This script returns the element's angle with respect to their parent
--   Customer     : None

-- BEGIN META DATA
--<luaelementfield>
-- <name>Angle with Parent</name>
-- <type>floatTypeEnum</type>
-- <category>fieldCategoryGeneral</category>
-- <getfunction>getParentAngle</getfunction>
-- <setfunction></setfunction>
--</luaelementfield>
-- END META DATA

function getAngle(v1, v2)
    local inX, inY -- intersection of v1 and v2
    local v1x, v1y -- v1 endpoint
    local v2x, v2y -- v2 endpoint
    inX, inY = v1:altLocation() -- same as v2:location()
    v1x, v1y = v1:location() 
    v2x, v2y = v2:altLocation()
    
    local rel1X, rel1Y
    rel1X = v1x - inX
    rel1Y = v1y - inY

    local rel2X, rel2Y
    rel2X = v2x - inX
    rel2Y = v2y - inY

    -- (rel1X, rel1Y) = downline point relative intersection
    -- (rel2X, rel2Y) = upline point relative intersection
    local mag1 = math.sqrt(rel1X*rel1X + rel1Y*rel1Y)
    local mag2 = math.sqrt(rel2X*rel2X + rel2Y*rel2Y)

    local cosAngle = (rel1X*rel2X + rel1Y*rel2Y)/(mag1*mag2)
    local angle = math.acos(cosAngle)*180/math.pi
    return angle
end

-- WARNING: RECURSIVE FUNCTION --
function getParentTarget(element, parent)
    if(parent == nil or parent == Model.rootElement()) then
        return nil
    elseif(parent:elementType() == "Overhead" or parent:elementType() == "Underground") then
        return parent
    else
        return getParentTarget(element, parent:parent())
    end
end

-- MAIN FUNCTION --
function getParentAngle(element)
    if(type(element) ~= "userdata") then
        element = Model.getElementFromName(element)
    end
    if(element:elementType() ~= "Overhead" and element:elementType() ~= "Underground") then
        return 0.0
    end
    local parent = getParentTarget(element, element:parent())
    if(parent == nil) then
        return 0.0
    else
        return getAngle(element, parent)
    end
end

  local i = 1

-- END META DATA

local HOURS_IN_MONTH = 24*31

function round( n, idp )
	local mult = 10^(idp or 1) -- default precision of 1 place
	return math.floor( n*mult + 0.5 )/mult
end

function loadFactor( activeElement ) 
	local e = Model.getElementFromName( activeElement )
	if not e or e:elementType() ~= 'Consumer' then return 0.0 end
	local totalKwh = 0
	for i=1, 4 do -- Load Groups 1 to 4
		for j=65, 67 do -- A to C
			local ph = string.char( j )
			local kwh = e:getElementField( 'Load Group '..i..' Kwh '..ph )
			if not kwh then kwh = 0.0 end
			totalKwh = totalKwh + kwh
		end
	end
	local kw = e:getElementField( 'Kw On Element' )
	if not kw then kw = 0.0 end
	if kw == 0 then return 0.0 end
	return round( totalKwh/( kw*HOURS_IN_MONTH )*100 )
end

-- BEGIN META DATA
--<luaelementfield>
-- <name>Miles in Zone</name>
-- <type>floatTypeEnum</type>
-- <category>fieldCategoryGeneral</category>
-- <getfunction>main</getfunction>
-- <setfunction></setfunction>
--</luaelementfield>
-- END META DATA

function round(num, idp)
	local mult = 10^( idp or 0 )
	return math.floor( num * mult + 0.5 ) / mult
end

function feetToMiles( feet )
	return round( tonumber( feet ) / 5280, 3 )
end

List = {}
function List.new()
	return { first = 0, last = -1 }
end

function List.push_back( list, value )
	local last = list.last + 1
	list.last = last
	list[ last ] = value
	return value
end

function List.pop_front( list )
	local first = list.first
	if ( first > list.last ) then return nil end
	local value = list[ first ]
	list[ first ] = nil
	list.first = first + 1
	return value
end

function List.empty( list )
	return ( list.first > list.last )
end

function main( e )
	local myList = List.new()
	local ele = Model.getElementFromName( e )
	List.push_back( myList, ele )
	local totalLength = 0
	while not List.empty( myList ) do
		local element = List.pop_front( myList )
		local eType = element:elementType()
		if eType == 'Overhead' or eType == 'Underground' then
			local length = element:getElementField( 'Impedance Length' )
			if not length then length = 0.0 end
			totalLength = totalLength + length
		end
		local children = element:children()
		for _, child in ipairs( children ) do
			List.push_back( myList, child )
		end
	end
	return feetToMiles( totalLength )
end

end

artifacts.source:
-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Neutral Current (amps).elua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2
--   Input        : an element
--   Return       : neutral current value or nil
--   Description  : This script determines the neutral current of an element
--   Customer     : None
-- END DESCRIPTION

-- BEGIN META DATA
--<luaelementfield>
-- <name>Neutral Current (amps)</name>
-- <type>floatTypeEnum</type>
-- <category>fieldCategoryGeneral</category>
-- <getfunction>NCurrent</getfunction>
-- <setfunction></setfunction>
--</luaelementfield>
-- END META DATA

-- Neutral Current
-------------------
-- Existing element fields "thru amps" should be used in the summation. 
--     Delta connected, there will be zero neutral current.
--     Y connected, the neutral current is the summation of the phases involved.
--                  For single phase, the neutral current will be the same as the 
--                  phase thru amps.

function round( num, idp )
	local mult = 10^( idp or 0 )
	return math.floor( num * mult + 0.5 ) / mult
end

function NCurrent( activeElement )
	if ElementExists( activeElement ) then
		local e = Model.getElementFromName( activeElement )
		local eType = e:getElementField( 'Line Connection' )
		if eType == 'Delta' then
			return '0'
		elseif eType == 'Wye' then
			local ThruA  = e:getElementField( 'Thru Amps A' )
			if not ThruA then ThruA = 0.0 end
			local ThruB  = e:getElementField( 'Thru Amps B' ) 
			if not ThruB then ThruB = 0.0 end
			local ThruC  = e:getElementField( 'Thru Amps C' ) 
			if not ThruC then ThruC = 0.0 end
			local AngleA = e:getElementField( 'Actual Angle A' )
			if not AngleA then AngleA = 0.0 end
			local AngleB = e:getElementField( 'Actual Angle B' )
			if not AngleB then AngleB = 0.0 end
			local AngleC = e:getElementField( 'Actual Angle C' )
			if not AngleC then AngleC = 0.0 end

			local ReA = ThruA * math.cos( math.rad( AngleA ) )
			local ImA = ThruA * math.sin( math.rad( AngleA ) )

			local ReB = ThruB * math.cos( math.rad( AngleB ) )
			local ImB = ThruB * math.sin( math.rad( AngleB ) )

			local ReC = ThruC * math.cos( math.rad( AngleC ) )
			local ImC = ThruC * math.sin( math.rad( AngleC ) )

			local Re  = ReA + ReB + ReC
			local Im  = ImA + ImB + ImC

			local NC = math.sqrt( Re*Re + Im*Im )
			local NeutralC = round( NC,4 )

			return NeutralC
		end
	end
	return nil
end

artifacts.source:
-- BEGIN DESCRIPTION
--   File Name    : Upline Load Control Point.elua
--   Version      : WindMil 8.2
--   Input        : an element
--   Return       : upline load control point
--   Description  : This script returns the name of the upline load control point
--   Customer     : None
-- END DESCRIPTION

-- BEGIN META DATA
--<luaelementfield>
-- <name>Upline Load Control Point</name>
-- <type>stringTypeEnum</type>
-- <category>fieldCategoryGeneral</category>
-- <getfunction>main</getfunction>
-- <setfunction></setfunction>
--</luaelementfield>
-- END META DATA

-- If multiparent nodes exist upline, then a string of
-- upline control points will be returned.

List = {}
function List.new()
	return { first = 0, last = -1 }
end

function List.push_back( list, value )
	local last = list.last + 1
	list.last = last
	list[ last ] = value
	return value
end

function List.pop_front( list )
	local first = list.first
	if ( first > list.last ) then return nil end
	local value = list[ first ]
	list[ first ] = nil
	list.first = first + 1
	return value
end

function List.empty( list )
	return ( list.first > list.last )
end

function strJoin( old, new, delimiter )
	if not old then
		old = ''
	end
	if not new then
		new = ''
	end

	if #old > 0 and not string.find( old, new ) and new ~= old then
		return old..delimiter..' '..new
	else
		return new
	end
end

function uplineLCP( e ) 
	local lcpStr = ''
	local ancestor
	local prevParent = e
	local upLineSrc  = e:getElementField( 'Upline Source' )
	while true do
		if prevParent and upLineSrc ~= prevParent then
			ancestor = prevParent:parent()
			aType = ancestor:elementType()
			isMP = ancestor:getElementField( 'Multi-Parent Node' )
			if aType == 'Source' or aType == 'Device' or ( aType == 'Node' and not isMP ) then
				if ancestor:getElementField( 'Is Load Control Point' ) then
					lcpStr = strJoin( lcpStr, ancestor:name(), ',' )
					break
				else
					prevParent = ancestor
				end
			elseif aType == 'Node' and isMP then
				local myList = List.new()
				local mParents = ancestor:getMultiparents()
				for i=1, 3 do
					if mParents then
						List.push_back( myList, mParents[i] )
					end
				end

				while not List.empty( myList ) do
					local thisParent = List.pop_front( myList )
					local recurse = uplineLCP( thisParent )
					if recurse ~= '' then
						lcpStr = strJoin( lcpStr, recurse, ',' )
					end
				end
				break
			else
				prevParent = ancestor
			end
		else
			break
		end
	end
	return lcpStr
end

function main( elt )
	local e = Model.getElementFromName( elt )
	if e:getElementField( 'Multi-Parent Node' ) then
		local child = e:children()
		return uplineLCP( child[1] )
	else
		return uplineLCP( e )
	end
end
